articles.title: Partial collapse of Pakistan’s Tarbela dam causes flood water surge
articles.description: A protective barrier collapsed at the partially-constructed Tarbela Dam T-5 hydropower project in Pakistan.

articles.headline: Krakow shooting suspect dies in hospital after attack
articles.title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
articles.summary: A 24-year-old gunman suspected of killing six people in central Krakow died in hospital early Monday following a shootout with armed police. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the attack as terrorism and announced two days of national mourning, while investigators indicated the suspect was inspired by far-right ideologies and had previously killed three family members.
articles.description: Six people were killed in the shooting, and three bodies of the suspect's family members were found at their home.

articles.headline: Three family members found dead in Gachibowli apartment on November 8
articles.title: Three family members found dead in Gachibowli apartment
articles.summary: Three members of a family were discovered dead inside their flat at Jayabheri Nirvana in Gowlidoddi, Gachibowli, on November 8, 2026. Police identified the deceased as 65-year-old Bathula Marreddy, his 60-year-old wife Bharathi, and their 38-year-old software employee son Nishanth Reddy. Preliminary information indicates health and personal problems, while Gachibowli police have launched an investigation to establish the exact circumstances surrounding the tragic incident.

articles.headline: Association challenges empty bottle buyback scheme and liquor price hike in court
articles.title: TASMAC liquor price hike: Association of recreation clubs, star hotels challenges empty bottle buyback scheme in Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: An association of recreation clubs and star hotels filed a petition in the Madras High Court challenging a 2022 circular regarding an empty liquor bottle buyback scheme in Tamil Nadu. The petition targets a November 1, 2026, price hike that imposed a ten rupee environmental and social welfare cess per bottle. The petitioner argues the policy unfairly burdens clubs whose members consume liquor privately.
articles.description: The petitioner association claims that an environmental and social welfare cess of ₹10 per bottle cannot be imposed on recreation clubs and the latter cannot be expected to collect empty bottles from the residences of its members

articles.headline: Polish police confirm death of Krakow shooting spree suspect in hospital
articles.title: Krakow shooting suspect dies: Poland police
articles.summary: Regional police in Poland announced on November 9, 2026, that the 24-year-old man accused of killing six people during a weekend shooting in central Krakow died in hospital. The suspect had been in critical condition after sustaining wounds in a shootout with police following the attack that occurred on November 7, 2026.
articles.description: The gunman was wounded in a shootout with police and had been in critical condition in hospital

articles.headline: Paraguay former president’s mansion raided in ongoing investigation
articles.title: Paraguay former president’s mansion raided in ongoing investigation
articles.description: A hidden vault was found in Paraguay's former president's mansion amid ongoing banking scandal investigation.

articles.headline: Kremlin hopes U.S. midterm results will not alter Trump peace efforts
articles.title: Kremlin hopes U.S. election shake-up won't shift Trump's negotiations on Ukraine
articles.summary: Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated on November 8, 2026, that Russia hopes United States President Donald Trump will continue his peace efforts despite the Republican defeat in the midterm elections. Trilateral negotiations involving Russian, Ukrainian, and American representatives are scheduled for November 10 and November 11 in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, amid ongoing international discussions regarding European security and humanitarian truces.
articles.description: Mr. Peskov shrugged off a question from reporters on whether the new Congress would challenge Mr. Trump's stance on Russia and Ukraine. He called it an “internal matter” for the U.S.

articles.headline: U.S. military disables cargo vessel attempting to break blockade
articles.title: U.S. military says it disabled cargo vessel in Gulf of Oman
articles.summary: An American military aircraft fired precision munitions and disabled a St. Kitts-flagged cargo vessel on November 7, 2026, after it tried to leave regional waters following an Iranian port visit, the U.S. Central Command stated. The command also launched a task force to target advanced weapon smuggling, estimating its naval blockade has blocked over $25 billion in crude oil exports.
articles.description: The St. Kitts-flagged cargo vessel tried to ‌depart regional waters after visiting ‌an ⁠Iranian port, and a U.S. plane fired precision munitions at its stern after U.S. forces ​directed the crew to ‌abandon targeted spaces, Central Command said

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh overhauls fireworks safety framework following fatal manufacturing blasts
articles.title: Andhra Pradesh tightens fireworks safety rules after fatal blasts
articles.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government introduced a strict centralized monitoring and risk-based inspection framework on November 7, 2026, following deadly explosions at manufacturing units. Led by Chief Secretary G. Sai Prasad, the reforms establish a State Explosives and Fireworks Safety Cell and district committees. Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu also reviewed recent fire accidents caused by firecrackers and electrical faults across Rajam, Gannavaram, and Tiruvuru.
articles.description: New nodal authorities, dedicated safety cell and digital monitoring portal planned; officials to face accountability for lapses

articles.headline: Anuj Shrivatri wins chess championship to become India hundredth grandmaster
articles.title: Anuj Shrivatri completes India’s century of Grandmasters | Data
articles.summary: Anuj Shrivatri secured the title of India's hundredth grandmaster on November 8, 2026, by winning the 7th ASEAN+ Individual Open Chess Championship in Ozamiz City, the Philippines. The twenty-two-year-old from Katni scored seven points across nine rounds. This victory marks a double milestone as he becomes the first grandmaster from Madhya Pradesh.
articles.description: Shrivatri becomes the first Grandmaster from Madhya Pradesh, while Tamil Nadu continues to lead the country’s tally, accounting for 38% of India’s Grandmasters

articles.headline: Delhi air quality sparks row over missing pollution monitoring data
articles.title: Delhi AQI: What is PM2.5 and the row over air pollution data post Deepavali?
articles.summary: Delhi experienced severely high air pollution levels on Deepavali night after firecrackers were burst past permitted hours, placing the national capital under Stage III of the Graded Response Action Plan. A political dispute erupted on Monday as Congress leader Ajay Maken flagged the non-availability of PM 2.5 readings across 25 of the city's 39 monitoring stations during the festival.
articles.description: Congress leader Ajay Maken flagged the non-availability of PM 2.5 readings at 25 of Delhi’s 39 air quality monitoring stations on the night of Deepavali

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu opposition leaders criticise Chief Minister Vijay over Deepavali murders.
articles.title: AIADMK, AMMK leaders lash out at CM Vijay over Deepavali day murders across Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: Opposition leaders in Tamil Nadu strongly condemned Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay on November 9, 2026, following multiple murders reported across the state on Deepavali day. All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami and Amma Makkal Munnetra Kazhagam founder T.T.V. Dhinakaran criticised the administration for failing to maintain law and order, specifically highlighting the fatal lynching of a special sub-inspector in Theni district.
articles.description: Edappadi Palaniswami and T.T.V. Dhinakaran came down heavily on the TVK-led government.

articles.headline: Iran hardens domestic security controls and dissent punishments amid US strike threats.
articles.title: Iran’s authorities harden domestic security controls amid US strike threats
articles.summary: Iran has heightened domestic security measures and intensified warnings against public dissent during an ongoing war with the United States. Authorities are cracking down on perceived opposition in public spaces, including halting Halloween gatherings in Tehran, while the judiciary continues executing individuals convicted of political crimes and alleged espionage following nationwide protests.
articles.description: Iran is cracking down on perceived security threats from alleged spies to crowds of youngsters.

articles.headline: Sonia Gandhi discusses political challenges and memoir in recent interview
articles.title: Sonia Gandhi’s memoir: How a love story grew into a deep belonging to India
articles.summary: Former Congress president Sonia Gandhi stated in an interview published by The Hindu that current governance has damaged Indian institutions. Released by HarperCollins India, her memoir explores her transition into public life. She addressed historical events, her foreign origin controversy, and her 2004 decision to decline the prime ministership, expressing optimism regarding upcoming electoral prospects alongside opposition parties.
articles.description: Sonia Gandhi’s much-awaited Belonging is a personal memoir, with politics providing the background or “a kind of framework,” as she puts it in the book

articles.headline: Amit Shah sets a 2028 deadline to make Gujarat completely drug-free.
articles.title: Amit Shah sets 2028 deadline for drug-free Gujarat, urges citizens to report narcotics sales
articles.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah urged citizens to report narcotics activity during an event on November 9, 2026, where he inaugurated development projects worth ₹1,024 crore in Gujarat. He established a target for Gujarat to eradicate drugs by December 31, 2028, ahead of a national deadline of December 31, 2029, emphasizing that public participation and vigilance from teachers and guardians are essential.
articles.description: The Union Home Minister said Gujarat should be drug-free by December 31, 2028, a year ahead of the national deadline, and announced a State control room from December 1

articles.headline: Six family members killed in Madhya Pradesh building fire
articles.title: Twelve killed in two fire incidents in Madhya Pradesh on Deepavali; infant dies in mother’s lap in Katni
articles.summary: A devastating fire broke out at a crockery shop inside a three-storey building in Barhi town of Madhya Pradesh on November 9, 2026, resulting in the deaths of six family members. According to Katni Collector Ashish Tiwari, the blaze started around midnight and overwhelmed the structure due to highly flammable materials stored on the lower floor.
articles.description: Chief Minister Mohan Yadav condoled the deaths and announced an ex-gratia of ₹4 lakh each to the families of the deceased

articles.headline: Karnataka lab tests reveal petrol ethanol blends exceeding twenty percent
articles.title: Lab tests show ethanol blend in E20 petrol as high as 31% in Karnataka
articles.summary: Karnataka Food and Civil Supplies Minister Rizwan Arshad announced on November 6, 2026, that laboratory tests showed ethanol blending in petrol reached up to 31.2 percent across several districts. Arshad criticized oil marketing companies for lacking transparency and demanded Union Government compensation for consumers whose vehicles face potential damage from excessive ethanol concentrations exceeding permitted limits.
articles.description: Minister for Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs of Karnataka demands penalising OMCs, an E20 spoilage fund to compensate consumers

articles.headline: New Zealand voters reject major political parties amid a deepening economic crisis
articles.title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
articles.summary: Voters across New Zealand participated in a general election on Saturday amid widespread public dissatisfaction and record low confidence in the political system. Citizens face soaring living costs, high unemployment, and severe healthcare strains, driving a massive exodus of residents abroad while minor political parties made unprecedented electoral gains.
articles.description: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.

articles.headline: Chess player Anuj Shrivatri becomes India's one hundredth grandmaster in the Philippines
articles.title: It’s really great to see hard work pay off, says Anuj Shrivatri on becoming India’s 100th GM
articles.summary: Twenty-two-year-old Anuj Shrivatri achieved the grandmaster title after winning the seventh ASEAN open individual championship in the Philippines. The player from Madhya Pradesh stated that he maintained focus on decision-making rather than results during the final rounds of the tournament. Following this milestone, Shrivatri aims to surpass a 2600 rating and secure victories in multiple upcoming international chess competitions.
articles.description: Shrivatri said becoming a GM was his main aim and now that he had achieved it, the focus is to “cross 2600 rating barrier

articles.headline: Anuj Shrivatri wins tournament to become India's 100th chess Grandmaster
articles.title: Anuj Shrivatri becomes India’s 100th chess Grandmaster
articles.summary: Anuj Shrivatri became India's 100th chess Grandmaster by winning the seventh ASEAN+ Individual Open chess championship in Ozamiz City, the Philippines. The 22-year-old secured seven points from nine rounds after an opening loss, also becoming the first Grandmaster from Madhya Pradesh. Viswanathan Anand became the country's first Grandmaster in 1988.
articles.description: The 22-year-old won the 7th ASEAN+ Individual Open chess championship in Ozamiz City, the Philippines

articles.headline: Police clash with protesters as anti-government rallies sweep France
articles.title: Police clash with protesters as anti-government rallies sweep France
articles.description: Police have clashed with protesters in Paris as Yellow Vests defied a ban on their rally, leading to arrests.

articles.headline: Bengaluru police arrest cab driver Indushekhar for seven murders
articles.title: A missing persons complaint that unravelled Bengaluru’s seven murders
articles.summary: Bengaluru police apprehended a cab driver named Indushekhar for allegedly murdering seven relatives following a missing persons complaint filed by Tungamma on November 3, 2026. The victims include his wife Sunita and mother-in-law Roopavathi, along with several members of their extended family. While family members alleged police inaction, City Police Commissioner Seemant Kumar Singh stated that an investigation into the matter is underway.
articles.description: Senior police officers said that Sunita, the accused’s wife, and Roopavathi, his mother-in-law, were the first to be murdered.

articles.headline: Parliament Monsoon session remains unprorogued for record 88 days
articles.title: Parliament’s monsoon session remains unprorogued for record 88 days
articles.summary: The Indian Parliament's Monsoon session remained unprorogued for 88 days as of Monday, breaking a 2008 record. Both Houses were adjourned indefinitely on August 13. The government's decision leaves open the possibility of a short-notice sitting to consider a constitutional amendment for the Women's Reservation Bill, which requires a minimum notice of two days.
articles.description: As of November 9, 2026 morning, neither the Lok Sabha nor the Rajya Sabha had been formally prorogued, keeping open the possibility of convening an extended sitting of the existing session

articles.headline: Congress criticises unprorogued Parliament session amid delimitation bill concerns
articles.title: Prorogation record set to give time to Shah to manipulate ‘super-tainted’ 2/3rd majority: Congress
articles.summary: The Congress party criticised the Modi government on Monday for leaving Parliament's monsoon session unprorogued for a record 88 days since its adjournment on August 13. Opposition leaders alleged the delay is intended to give Union Home Minister Amit Shah time to manipulate a two-thirds majority in the Lok Sabha to pass controversial delimitation bills despite previous legislative setbacks.
articles.description: The Opposition party also pointed out that Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi four times in the past six months requesting that an all-party meeting on delimitation be convened

articles.headline: Police investigate how accused transported seven bodies across locations without detection
articles.title: Bengaluru family murders: How did the accused transport bodies across locations without being detected?
articles.summary: Indushekar allegedly transported his wife and six family members in a car across multiple locations including Mysuru and the Tamil Nadu border over a 15-day period without being intercepted by police checkpoints. According to The Hindu, a senior police officer stated that authorities are reviewing patrol negligence and whether the suspect deliberately avoided tolls.
articles.description: Neither a patrolling vehicle nor a checkpoint detected the accused Indushekhar even as he crossed State borders

articles.headline: India records twenty-eight percent decline in oilmeal exports during the April-August period
articles.title: India’s April-August oilmeal exports fall 28.5% as soymeal loses to Brazil, Argentina
articles.summary: India's outbound shipments of oilmeals dropped to twelve lakh tonnes during the first five months of the financial year due to a significant decrease in soybean meal sales. The Solvent Extractors Association of India stated that Indian soybean meal struggled with pricing pressure against competitors from Argentina and Brazil. Strong domestic demand and elevated maritime freight costs further constrained export volumes across key Asian markets.
articles.description: Soybean meal shipments plunged 73% as cheaper supplies from Argentina and Brazil captured market share, the Solvent Extractors’ Association of India said

articles.headline: Defence minister Rajnath Singh calls for highest military preparedness at Bagdogra Air Force station
articles.title: Rajnath Singh warns of evolving threats, calls for highest military readiness
articles.summary: Indian Defence Minister Rajnath Singh urged armed forces personnel at the Bagdogra Air Force station in West Bengal to maintain high operational readiness amid an increasingly complex security landscape. Speaking near the frontier with China, Singh highlighted emerging threats including cyber attacks, proxy wars, and misinformation campaigns, while reaffirming the government's push for indigenous defence technologies through start-ups.
articles.description: Addressing personnel at key airbase near China frontier, Defence Minister warns of adversaries exploiting ‘vulnerabilities’; he also reviews Army’s LAC infrastructure, operational preparedness and lauds initiatives aimed at strengthening ties with local communities

articles.headline: President Donald Trump states he was joking about offering Dana White press secretary role
articles.title: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump clarified that his social media post offering the White House press secretary position to Ultimate Fighting Championship chief executive Dana White was intended as a joke. The clarification followed a social media announcement where Trump stated White had been offered the job and urged him to accept it. The press secretary position has remained vacant since October following the departure of Katie Zacharia.
articles.description: The president told the Ultimate Fighting Championship boss to "please take the job" in a Truth Social post on Saturday.

articles.headline: Stubble burning worsens severe air pollution across the Indo-Gangetic Plain
articles.title: How governmentality exacerbates the problem of farmers’ stubble burning
articles.summary: Every November, the Indo-Gangetic Plain suffers from heavy pollution as monsoon winds cease and temperature drops trap vehicular and industrial emissions beneath an inversion layer. According to research published in April 2025 by S. R. Jagadale and J. M. Shaikh, farmers in Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh worsen this toxic haze by burning rice chaff to prepare fields for Rabi wheat, representing the cheapest clearance method.
articles.description: A new study by researchers Sujit Raghunathrao Jagadale and Javed M. Shaikh at the Indian Institute of Management, Amritsar analyses the problem of stubble burning from the lens of ‘governmentality’ and market failure

articles.headline: Keralam public health experts urge epidemiological review amid measles outbreaks
articles.title: Keralam measles outbreaks call for a relook at disease epidemiology
articles.summary: Public health experts in Keralam are calling for a reassessment of disease epidemiology as measles outbreaks affect districts including Kozhikode, Malappuram, and Palakkad with 824 confirmed cases. The Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme reported five deaths, while research highlights infections crossing age groups, breakthrough cases in vaccinated children, and waning maternal antibodies affecting infants.
articles.description: Once predominantly a childhood disease affecting children aged one to five, measles is now being reported across age groups, including among fully vaccinated individuals and infants below nine months, who are not yet eligible for routine measles vaccination

articles.headline: Punjab records record single-day surge in farm fires during Deepavali
articles.title: At 1,152, Punjab records season’s biggest single-day jump in farm fires on Deepavali
articles.summary: Punjab recorded 1,152 farm fires on Deepavali, pushing the seasonal total to 4,459 by November 8, 2026, according to official data. Tarn Taran led with 654 cases. Despite advisories and ₹62 lakh in environmental fines, enforcement agencies registered 884 FIRs under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and marked 1,017 red entries. The Commission for Air Quality Management subsequently urged bureaucrats to intensify monitoring and hold nodal officers accountable.
articles.description: The latest figures indicate a significant rise in crop residue burning despite government advisories, enforcement measures and monetary penalties aimed at discouraging the practice

articles.headline: Trump concedes deportation policy may have alienated voters in midterms
articles.title: Trump says his immigration policy ‘too tough’ for voters
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump acknowledged that his deportation policy may have been too extreme for voters, contributing to his party losing control of the House of Representatives and Senate. Speaking on CBS on November 8, Trump suggested working with the Democratic-controlled Congress on a moderate immigration agreement while appointing hardliner Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff, amid protests over enforcement operations.
articles.description: Trump concedes some voters were unhappy with his administration's controversial deportation drive.

articles.headline: Thousands of demonstrators protest across France against rising cost of living
articles.title: More than 140,000 rally as new protests against rising costs sweep France
articles.summary: Tens of thousands of protesters rallied across France for a fourth consecutive weekend to demonstrate against the rising cost of living. The Ministry of the Interior reported 146,000 participants nationwide, while unions estimated 250,000 demonstrators. The protests involved heavy security deployments, clashes in Paris and Lyon, and occurred ahead of the presidential election scheduled for April.
articles.description: Tear gas fired in Paris and Lyon as interior minister warns authorities are 'ready and waiting' for rioters and looters.

articles.headline: Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia faces threat as Russian drones close in
articles.title: Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia faces threat as Russian drones close in
articles.description: Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia, once a refuge for those fleeing the war, is now facing growing danger.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu faces water crisis and lower rice production risks
articles.title: T.N. may be heading towards a water crisis, unless northeast monsoon comes to the rescue
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu faces a potential water crisis and lower rice production as major irrigation reservoir storage sits at one-third of combined capacity. The State government demanded Karnataka release 20.7 tmcft during meetings with the Cauvery Water Management Authority. However, the authority ratified a recommendation for Karnataka to release only 3.88 tmcft over 15 days starting November 7, 2026.
articles.description: As of now, the aggregate storage in the major 15 irrigation reservoirs is about a third of the combined capacity of the reservoirs. In the corresponding period last year, the combined storage was around 92%

articles.headline: Foreign portfolio investors return to Indian equities with strong inflows
articles.title: Early November trend indicates return of FPIs into Indian equities
articles.summary: Foreign institutional investors purchased a net ₹45,960 crore of Indian shares during the five trading sessions ending November 6, 2026, signaling a potential return of foreign portfolio investors after September withdrawals. Provisional exchange data showed this recovery coincided with an 8.58% rise in the Nifty 50. Analysts attribute the shift to domestic economic resilience and long-term growth prospects, though global volatility and external macroeconomic headwinds remain.
articles.description: Provisional exchange data show that foreign institutional investors purchased Indian shares worth a net ₹45,960 crore during the five trading sessions ended on November 6, 2026

articles.headline: Marco Bezzecchi wins Qatar Grand Prix as Marc Marquez awaits title
articles.title: MotoGP: Bezzecchi denies Marquez world title as motorsport returns to Qatar
articles.summary: Marc Marquez delayed his eighth MotoGP title bid after finishing behind Marco Bezzecchi at the Qatar Grand Prix in Lusail on November 8. Pole-sitter Bezzecchi secured his sixth win of the season, cutting his deficit to 74 points. Meanwhile, Jorge Martin finished seventh to keep his championship hopes alive despite trailing by 60 points, as motorsport returned to the region following the war on Iran.
articles.description: Aprilia's Marco Bezzecchi wins Qatar Grand Prix as Ducati's Marc Marquez finishes second.

articles.headline: West Bengal chief minister defends police encounter killing in Raiganj
articles.title: CM Suvendu defends encounter in Raiganj, says police entitled to retaliate in self-defence
articles.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari defended the fatal police shooting of a rape-murder accused during an exchange of fire in Raiganj on November 9, 2026. Speaking in Digha, he stated that officers possess operational freedom and self-defence rights regarding serious crimes. The incident marks the fourth police encounter death in the state since May.
articles.description: The CM’s comments came hours after a man accused of raping and murdering his 13-year-old niece in Raiganj was killed in an exchange of fire with police

articles.headline: Tech executive Alice Huang accused of espionage targeting Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
articles.title: Who is Alice Huang, Chinese executive accused of spying on Nvidia CEO?
articles.summary: Chinese executive Alice Huang was accused by media reports of spying for Beijing during a relationship with Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang. According to the New York Times, US officials concluded she targeted the Nvidia boss while serving as a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed International, which has faced investigations regarding chip exports.
articles.description: Public details are sparse about the woman, also known as Huang Le, who had reportedly been a top figure at a Singapore-based data centre company called Megaspeed International

articles.headline: Revised maximum retail prices for anti-cancer drugs take effect
articles.title: Revised MRPs of 1,364 anti-cancer formulations come into effect; consumers to save ₹3,540 crore/year
articles.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority implemented revised maximum retail prices for 1,364 anti-cancer formulations on November 9, 2026. According to the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, eighty-five pharmaceutical companies reported reductions exceeding 50 percent for 679 brands. The initiative aims to save consumers approximately 3,540 crore rupees annually.
articles.description: According to the Ministry, 85 pharmaceutical companies have reported revised MRPs for 1,364 anti-cancer formulations across 121 drugs as of November 8, 2026

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh plans major restructuring of postgraduate education in universities
articles.title: Andhra Pradesh plans major overhaul of postgraduate education across 28 universities | Explained
articles.summary: The Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education proposed a comprehensive overhaul of postgraduate education across 28 state universities. The reforms aim to transform traditional institutions into specialised regional knowledge hubs. This restructuring focuses heavily on enhancing student employability, research capabilities, entrepreneurship, and regional economic development across the state.
articles.description: Proposed reforms seek to move beyond conventional, examination-orientated degrees towards interdisciplinary learning, industry exposure, research and emerging technologies

articles.headline: United States President Donald Trump orders Department of Justice to investigate Democrats
articles.title: Trump orders DOJ to investigate Democrats for ‘threatening’ people
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump directed the Department of Justice to investigate Democratic lawmakers for alleged threats following their midterm election victory. Writing on social media, Trump claimed without evidence that Democratic probes into his administration and associates amounted to criminal extortion. Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the November elections, granting them investigative powers.
articles.description: Trump lashed out at Democrats on Truth Social days after the party won control of Congress.

articles.headline: What do we know about Nvidia CEO’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy?
articles.title: What do we know about Nvidia CEO’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy?
articles.description: Adoration for the US tech giant’s CEO Jensen Huang has been labelled “Jensanity”, but can his reputation survive the news of his affair?

articles.headline: Yemeni government forces report battlefield advances as deadly strikes hit Sanaa
articles.title: Yemeni gov’t forces report advances as Houthis say deadly strikes hit Sanaa
articles.summary: Yemeni government forces reported repelling Houthi assaults and advancing in Marib and al-Jawf provinces during ongoing military operations. Meanwhile, the Houthi-run Saba news agency reported that air strikes killed at least 27 people and wounded about 30 others in al-Shariya village in Sanaa province. The Houthis blamed the Saudi-led coalition, while Al Jazeera could not independently verify the competing claims.
articles.description: Civilians bear the brunt of fighting as 27 people reported killed in strikes on a village in Sanaa province.

articles.headline: Krakow mass shooting suspect dies in hospital following arrest
articles.title: Poland mass shooting assailant dies in hospital, police say
articles.summary: The 24-year-old Polish man who killed six people in Krakow died in hospital on November 9, 2026. Police previously shot and arrested the gunman following the attack at the historic main square. Investigators subsequently discovered his family dead at home, while prosecutors launched an investigation into the incident as an act of terrorism.
articles.description: Suspect shot by police and arrested minutes ‌after gunfire opened on people in central Krakow.

articles.headline: Congress criticises Modi government over air pollution mortality rates in India
articles.title: Congress slams Modi govt. for being in ‘denial’ on impact of air pollution on mortality
articles.summary: Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh criticised the administration on November 9, 2026, for denying that air pollution causes high mortality, citing a FICCI-EY report attributing around two million deaths to pollution in 2023. Ramesh urged tightening PM2.5 and ozone standards and revamping the National Clean Air Programme. The remarks came as Delhi experienced severe air quality with an AQI of 370.
articles.description: Jairam Ramesh cited the FICCI-EY report and pointed out that it categorically states that around 2 million deaths (about 22% of total) were attributable to air pollution in India in 2023

articles.headline: Palestinians mark anniversary of Berlin Wall fall alongside West Bank barrier protests
articles.title: How Israel’s separation wall compares with the Berlin Wall
articles.summary: Palestinians marked the anniversary of the Berlin Wall fall on November 9, 2026, protesting Israel's separation wall in the occupied West Bank. Built starting in 2002 and declared illegal by the International Court of Justice in 2004, the barrier cuts through Palestinian territory, isolating communities and agricultural land while operating alongside hundreds of military checkpoints and roadblocks.
articles.description: How Israel's wall, checkpoints and permits divide Palestinians in the occupied West Bank and cut farmers off from land.

articles.headline: McLaren driver Lando Norris wins Sao Paulo Grand Prix as Mercedes claims title
articles.title: Sao Paulo GP: McLaren's Lando Norris wins as Mercedes seals Constructors' title
articles.summary: McLaren driver Lando Norris won the rainy Sao Paulo Grand Prix at Interlagos on November 8, 2026, leading 47 of 71 laps ahead of Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar. Meanwhile, Mercedes secured its first Formula 1 constructors' title since 2021, despite Kimi Antonelli finishing fifth. Norris celebrated his third season victory after starting from pole position.
articles.description: Lewis Hamilton became the second F1 driver with 400 starts after Fernando Alonso; Brazil’s home drivers have a disappointing race

articles.headline: Modernist artist Arpita Singh passes away at 89
articles.title: Modernist artist Arpita Singh, aged 89, passes away
articles.summary: Modernist artist Arpita Singh died at Fortis Hospital in New Delhi from age-related ailments on November 9, 2026, at the age of 89, according to her husband Paramjit Singh. Known for her figurative works exploring social upheaval, she received the Padma Bhushan in 2011. Her cremation is scheduled for November 15, 2026, at Lodhi Crematorium, leaving behind a legacy celebrated by cultural figures.
articles.description: Arpita Singh received the Padma Bhushan in 2011 and the Lalit Kala Akademi Fellowship in 2014 for her contribution to the world of art

articles.headline: Lando Norris wins Sao Paulo Grand Prix as Mercedes secure constructors title
articles.title: Lando Norris wins Sao Palo Grand Prix, but Mercedes seal constructors title
articles.summary: McLaren driver Lando Norris won the wet Sao Paulo Grand Prix from pole position on November 9, 2026, while Mercedes secured their ninth Formula One constructors world championship. Red Bull driver Max Verstappen finished second on a treacherous track, and Kimi Antonelli placed fifth with the fastest lap. Team boss Toto Wolff expressed pride in the organization following the wet race.
articles.description: Norris wins from pole position on a rainy Sao Paulo track as Mercedes win team title for the first time since 2021.

articles.headline: US offers twenty million dollars for Iran nuclear details
articles.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
articles.summary: The United States State Department announced a reward of up to twenty million dollars for information regarding Iran's nuclear programme, including facilities, equipment, and associated personnel. Meanwhile, United States Central Command established Task Force Iron Gate to restrict weapons movement and sanctioned material across Iranian borders, while regional mediators continued efforts to negotiate an end to the ongoing conflict.
articles.description: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.

articles.headline: Six people killed in Muzaffarnagar car fire after collision with pole
articles.title: Car catches fire after hitting electric pole in U.P.'s Muzaffarnagar, six dead
articles.summary: Six individuals died when their car collided with an electric pole and caught fire along the Shamli highway in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar district on November 9, 2026, according to police. Emergency responders transported the victims to the district hospital, where medical staff pronounced them dead. The occupants were travelling from Hisar in Haryana to Haridwar when the fatal accident occurred.
articles.description: The deceased have not yet been identified, and efforts are underway to establish their identities and inform their families

articles.headline: Maharashtra relaxes borewell restrictions until December 15 to combat drought
articles.title: Maharashtra relaxes borewell restrictions till December 15 to help farmers save trees amid drought
articles.summary: Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis announced a temporary relaxation of restrictions on drilling new borewells and deepening existing ones until December 15, 2026, to help farmers save trees during severe drought conditions. The measure requires prior authorization and is not universally applicable. Fadnavis made the announcement during a village interaction in Nagpur district following an 18.8 percent statewide rain deficit.
articles.description: The announcement came during an interaction with village sarpanches and local representatives at Lohari Sawanga in Nagpur district’s Narkhed taluka, where the Chief Minister had stayed overnight on November 7 to celebrate Deepavali with a farmer’s family

articles.headline: Houthis report 25 killed in Yemen strikes
articles.title: Houthis report 25 killed in Yemen strikes
articles.description: Yemen’s Houthis say at least 25 people have been killed and 30 injured in air strikes.

articles.headline: Pope Leo XIV critiques Argentine austerity measures
articles.title: Pope delivers veiled rebuke of Milei's austerity measures
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV delivered a pointed critique of President Javier Milei's austerity measures during a visit to Buenos Aires, arguing that economies must benefit the poor. The Argentine leader defended his libertarian policies in response, while discussing democracy and public spending during the second stop of the Pope's Latin American tour.
articles.description: Pope Leo made the comments as he arrived in Argentina on the second leg of his Latin America tour.

articles.headline: Turkiye places electrification at center of climate agenda
articles.title: Turkiye pushes electrification top of climate agenda as COP31 set to open
articles.summary: Turkiye launched the 35-by-35 Global Electrification Pledge as the COP31 climate conference opened in Antalya on Monday. Environment Minister Murat Kurum stated the initiative aims to make electricity account for thirty-five percent of global energy demand by 2035, though climate advocates criticized the non-binding pledge for lacking low-carbon requirements.
articles.description: Ankara aims to make electricity account for 35 percent of global energy demand by 2035.

articles.headline: Donald Trump clarifies Dana White press secretary comments
articles.title: A joke or test? Why Trump floated UFC’s Dana White as his press secretary
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump stated he was only joking after posting on Truth Social that Ultimate Fighting Championship Chief Executive Officer Dana White had been offered the role of White House press secretary. White acknowledged plans to meet Trump in Washington, DC, while dismissing prospects of joining the administration.
articles.description: White is a close friend of Trump and has endorsed him for president, but has never held a government position.

articles.headline: Ukraine says Russia intensifies strikes ahead of diplomatic peace talks
articles.title: Ukraine says Russia ramps up strikes to pressure Kyiv at talks
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Russia launched 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles on November 7, 2026, causing widespread power outages across five regions. The Energy Ministry reported severe transmission disruptions in Kyiv. Mr. Zelenskyy alleged Moscow aims to exert pressure ahead of U.S.-brokered trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi on November 10 and 11, while the Russian Defence Ministry confirmed strikes on military and energy infrastructure.
articles.description: Ukraine's Energy Ministry said "a massive attack on a number of energy facilities" had plunged five regions into darkness and significantly hampered electricity transmission in Kyiv and surrounding region

articles.headline: Yemeni Houthis launch drone and missile attacks targeting Saudi sites
articles.title: Saudi oil sites, troops and Riyadh airport targeted: Houthis
articles.summary: Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement carried out six military operations on November 7, 2026, targeting Saudi troops and infrastructure. According to military spokesperson Yahya Saree, the strikes hit Aramco oil facilities, Riyadh airport, and military installations on both sides of the border amid an ongoing conflict involving a Saudi-led coalition.
articles.description: The Iran-backed group, which is fighting a Saudi-led coalition backing Yemen's government, allegedly launched six operations

articles.headline: Indian rupee appreciates against US dollar in early trading session
articles.title: Rupee rises 24 paise to 93.74 against U.S. dollar in early trade
articles.summary: The Indian rupee appreciated 24 paise to reach 93.74 against the United States dollar during early trade on November 9, 2026. According to forex traders, the currency gained support from lower crude oil prices, improving foreign institutional investments, and potential de-escalation in West Asia. Brent crude traded near $98 per barrel following remarks by US President Donald Trump regarding potential diplomatic progress.
articles.description: Forex traders said the overall outlook for the rupee remains positive as any progress towards peace in the West Asia reduces the risk premium in crude oil and provides further support to the rupee

articles.headline: Election Commission reinstates oversight mechanism for IT head Dr. Seema Khanna
articles.title: What is the controversy over the oversight of ECI’s Director-General of IT? Explained
articles.summary: The Election Commission of India reintroduced an oversight mechanism on October 4 for information technology head Dr. Seema Khanna, requiring her files to route through Senior Deputy Election Commissioner Pawan Kumar Sharma. Previously, a July 28 order allowed direct file submission. The change followed letters from Election Commissioners S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi to Cabinet Secretary T.V. Somanathan.
articles.description: As per the current order, dated October 4, Ms. Khanna is required to route the files related to IT/ICT and Grievances/PGRS through Senior Deputy Election Commissioner Pawan Kumar Sharma, bringing back the oversight which the July 28 order had sought to remove

articles.headline: Stock markets decline in early trade due to IT losses and profit-taking
articles.title: Stock markets decline in early trade dragged by IT firms
articles.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty fell in early trade on November 9, 2026, driven by selling in technology firms and profit-taking after recent equities rallies. The BSE Sensex dropped 93.95 points to 80,919.19 while the NSE Nifty dipped 30 points to 24,968.80. Enrich Money CEO Ponmudi R noted that investors are weighing gains against potential near-term profit-taking and upcoming economic data.
articles.description: In the 30 Sensex firms, HCL Tech, Infosys, Power Grid, Bharti Airtel, UltraTech Cement and Tata Consultancy Services were among the major laggards

articles.headline: Health officials step up surveillance after Shigella outbreak in Malappuram
articles.title: Health officials step up surveillance as Shigella cases rise in Kerala’s Malappuram
articles.summary: Health authorities intensified surveillance in Malappuram district after eight people tested positive for Shigella infection, including five linked to an October 31 wedding feast in Elamkulam panchayat. Additional cases include a child and restaurant patrons receiving treatment at the Government District Hospital in Nilambur. Officials urged residents to consume boiled water and properly cooked food while food safety teams collected samples.
articles.description: Five of the eight Shigella cases reported in Malappuram district are linked to a wedding feast at Korakkuthu in Elamkulam panchayat near Perinthalmanna

articles.headline: Food safety regulator seizes thousands of tonnes of non-compliant items
articles.title: FSSAI seizes 3,280 tonne food items, cancels 52 licences in nationwide inspection drive
articles.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India inspected 56,431 food establishments between September 1 and November 5, 2026, seizing 3,280 tonnes of non-compliant products worth ₹82 crore. The nationwide enforcement drive led to the cancellation of 52 licences, suspension of 1,133 licences, and sealing of 314 establishments. The regulator stated the actions aimed to curb adulteration during the festive season.
articles.description: The regulator said it inspected 56,431 food establishments during its nationwide enforcement drive between September 1 and November 5, and seized non-compliant food products, including paneer, ghee, milk and sweets

articles.title: Israel builds 90km network of military roads across southern Lebanon
articles.description: Israel is building roads and military outposts across southern Lebanon.

articles.headline: World Bank brief highlights extreme poverty decline and high prosperity gap
articles.title: From poverty alleviation to prosperity
articles.summary: According to a World Bank brief, India experienced a significant decline in extreme poverty between 2011 and 2023, with hundreds of millions moving out of poverty. However, the report highlights a high prosperity gap driven by flat real earnings, low-productivity work, and rising youth unemployment, indicating that many individuals require substantial income increases to reach prosperity.
articles.description: India has reduced extreme poverty, but its high prosperity gap shows that millions remain far from a comfortable standard of living; informal work, stagnant wages and limited employment opportunities continue to constrain upward mobility

articles.headline: India targets series-clinching win against New Zealand in third ODI
articles.title: IND vs NZ third ODI: Rohit Sharma in focus as India eyes series-clinching win over New Zealand
articles.summary: India holds a 2-0 lead over an injury-ravaged New Zealand team heading into the third ODI at Seddon Park in Hamilton on November 10, 2026. Skipper Shubman Gill aims to secure the series victory before transitioning to red-ball preparation, while veteran Rohit Sharma faces intense scrutiny over his recent batting form under challenging, seamer-friendly conditions that have troubled both top orders.
articles.description: India lead 2-0 in the five-match rubber, but barring Virat Kohli's majestic knock at Eden Park, none of the other batters, including skipper Shubman Gill and the experienced Rohit, have looked particularly comfortable in conditions that have suited fast bowler

articles.headline: Five killed and at least 10 injured in Krakow shooting
articles.title: Five killed and at least 10 injured in Krakow shooting
articles.description: Five people have been killed and at least 10 injured in a shooting near the main market square in Krakow, Poland.

articles.headline: Asian stock markets rebound following previous tech sector losses
articles.title: Asian stock markets climb after earlier tech rout
articles.summary: Asian stock markets recovered on Monday following a tech rout driven by United States midterm election results and Nvidia's CEO investigation. Major indexes in Tokyo, Taipei, Seoul, and Hong Kong posted gains. The rebound mirrored Wall Street's recovery after a massive sell-off. Nvidia stated an independent inquiry would examine the chief executive officer's past relationship, though leadership maintained confidence in company security.
articles.description: Markets rebound after tech rout triggered by Democrats' sweeping victory in US midterm elections.

articles.headline: New Zealand general election ends without clear winner as major parties prepare for talks
articles.title: No clear winner after tight New Zealand general election
articles.summary: New Zealand faced political uncertainty following a tight general election where Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's National Party won forty-two seats and the Labour Party secured thirty-six. With neither major party achieving a majority, smaller groups like the Opportunity Party emerged as potential kingmakers. According to polling experts, cost of living pressures heavily influenced voter sentiment during the contest.
articles.description: Weeks of coalition talks could follow after preliminary results pointed to a highly divided national parliament.

articles.headline: Allahabad High Court criticises Uttar Pradesh Police over routine violations of fundamental rights
articles.title: Allahabad High Court slams U.P. Police over routine violations of fundamental rights
articles.summary: The Allahabad High Court strongly criticised the Uttar Pradesh Police for routine infringements on civil liberties while ordering the release of a petitioner who was allegedly detained unlawfully. Justices Atul Sreedharan and Achal Sachdev rejected the state's excuse regarding a malfunctioning CCTV system caused by a thunderstorm, noting that footage appeared to be deliberately withheld. The court also ordered the state to pay twenty thousand rupees in litigation costs.
articles.description: Ordering the release of a petitioner whose family alleged that he was forcibly picked up by police in plain clothes on September 5, the Bench says police appear to have little regard for constitutional freedoms

articles.headline: Mexican authorities arrest alleged cartel leader Rafael Alvarez in Zapopan
articles.title: Mexico arrests alleged major leader of Jalisco cartel
articles.summary: Mexican security forces arrested Rafael Alvarez, an alleged leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, during a Zapopan operation on Sunday. According to Security Minister Omar Garcia Harfuch, the suspect was wounded in a shootout and faces charges including aggravated homicide and US extradition. The operation involved intelligence sharing with the US Drug Enforcement Administration and resulted in 19 other arrests.
articles.description: Rafael Alvarez, alias 'R2', was captured with intelligence shared by the ⁠US Drug Enforcement Administration.

articles.headline: Trump defends Nvidia CEO amid Chinese spying allegations
articles.title: Trump defends Nvidia CEO amid Chinese spying allegations
articles.description: Donald Trump has defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China.

articles.headline: Five people killed in shooting near Krakow market square in Poland
articles.title: At least six people killed in shooting in Poland’s Krakow
articles.summary: Five people were killed and about a dozen others wounded during a shooting incident near the main market square in Krakow, Poland. Police stated that a gunman fired at random people from a vehicle before being neutralised by officers and transported to hospital. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk addressed the attack on social media, confirming that authorities were actively investigating the circumstances surrounding the tragic event.
articles.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk says police are investigating after 'tragic shooting' in second-largest city.

articles.headline: NDA partners secure victory in rural local body elections
articles.title: NDA seals YSRCP’s fate in rural local body polls by winning 499 ZPTC and 5,861 MPTC seats
articles.summary: National Democratic Alliance partners Telugu Desam Party, Jana Sena Party, and Bharatiya Janata Party won 499 Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituencies and 5,861 Mandal Parishad Territorial Constituencies, defeating the YSR Congress Party. Meanwhile, the State Election Commission scheduled Gram Panchayat polls in three phases for November 26 and 29 and December 2, lifting the Model Code of Conduct in urban bodies.
articles.description: State Election Commission set the stage for elections to Gram Panchayats in three phases i.e on November 26 and 29 and December 2, for which the Commission will issue notifications on November 13, 16 and 19

articles.headline: Supreme Court permits green firecrackers for two days in Delhi-NCR
articles.title: Deepavali 2026: All you need to know about Supreme Court-permitted time slots, green crackers and other directives
articles.summary: The Supreme Court permitted the use of certified green firecrackers during specific hours for two days in Delhi-NCR, describing Deepavali celebrations as a religious practice. The bench criticized state authorities for failing to enforce previous restrictions, set strict distance rules near hospitals and silence zones, and mandated QR codes for authorized low-emission products.
articles.description: The Supreme Court permitted the bursting of certified green firecrackers between 6 a.m. and 7 a.m. and between 8 p.m. and 10 p.m. on November 7 and November 8, 2026 in Delhi-NCR

articles.headline: Cruise ship pianist rescued from Pacific Ocean after nine hours
articles.title: Cruise ship pianist rescued from sea after nine hours in Pacific Ocean
articles.summary: A Royal Caribbean cruise ship pianist was rescued from the Pacific Ocean on Friday after spending approximately nine hours in the water. Two fishermen discovered the unidentified employee about 20 miles off the Californian coast near Catalina Island. He was hospitalized in stable condition, and the US Coast Guard is investigating the incident.
articles.description: Two US fishermen say they spotted the man treading water around 20 miles (32km) off the Californian coast.

articles.headline: Nineteen stranded Indian seafarers evacuated safely from Yemen
articles.title: 19 Indian seafarers stranded in Yemen evacuated, Embassy says
articles.summary: Nineteen Indian seafarers stranded in Hodeidah and Sana'a for two weeks were successfully evacuated and are returning home, according to an announcement by the Indian Embassy in Yemen on November 8, 2026. The diplomatic mission expressed gratitude for assistance in facilitating their departure. This follows a separate incident involving fourteen Indian nationals aboard a yacht near the Yemeni coast amid regional military escalations.
articles.description: The evacuation comes days after India said 14 Indian nationals aboard a yacht involved in an incident off the Yemeni coast were safe

articles.headline: Airstrikes in al-Shariya village near Sanaa kill twenty-two people
articles.title: Airstrike kills 22 people near Yemen's capital, Houthi official says
articles.summary: Attacks hit several homes in al-Shariya village near the Yemeni capital of Sanaa on November 7, 2026, resulting in twenty-two deaths and thirty injuries, mostly among women and children, according to Anees Alasbahi, a spokesman for the Houthi-run Health Ministry. Alasbahi attributed the assault to Saudi Arabia, though the claim remained unverified and the Saudi Information Ministry did not immediately respond. The incident follows a November 6 market strike in southern Yemen that killed at least thirty people amid escalating conflict between the Iranian-backed Houthis and Saudi-backed forces.
articles.description: Footage from Houthi-run Al-Masirah TV of the aftermath of November 7 strikes showed staff carrying limp bodies of young children out of ambulances, bringing the casualties to a local hospital

articles.headline: Russian drone and missile attacks escalate across Zaporizhzhia region
articles.title: ‘They started bombing us with drones’: Russian attacks unnerve Zaporizhzhia
articles.summary: Escalating Russian drone and missile strikes have forced residents from villages like Preobrazhenka into shelters in the Ukrainian regional capital of Zaporizhzhia. The attacks include a November 2 strike in Komyshuvakha that killed at least fifty people, alongside recent hits on bridges, shopping malls, and buses. Regional military administration official Denys Knysh stated that authorities are prepared to evacuate the city if security conditions deteriorate further, while displaced residents and local workers express fear and uncertainty regarding the ongoing conflict.
articles.description: A region once offering refuge becomes increasingly dangerous, as 50 people are killed in a single attack.

articles.headline: Gaza displacement camps collapse under rainwater
articles.title: Gaza displacement camps collapse under rainwater
articles.description: Rainwater is inundating displacement camps across Gaza as makeshift shelters collapse. Al Jazeera’s Nour Khaled reports.

articles.headline: Heavy rain floods Gaza camps and damages unsafe buildings
articles.title: Buildings damaged in Israeli bombings risk collapse as rain inundates Gaza
articles.summary: Severe storms and heavy rain on November 7, 2026, flooded displacement camps and damaged structures across the Gaza Strip, leaving thousands of displaced Palestinians shivering in soaked shelters. Water levels rose by thirty to forty centimetres in multiple camps, including al-Mina, while damaged buildings in Nuseirat faced collapse risks. Officials from the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs and the Gaza Municipality reported severe shortages of shelter supplies, fuel, and equipment to handle the widespread flooding and structural dangers.
articles.description: Floods have swept through Gaza after heavy rain, endangering families and putting war-damaged buildings at risk.

articles.headline: Heavy rains flood displacement camps across Gaza
articles.title: Heavy rains flood displacement camps across Gaza
articles.description: Heavy rains and strong winds have flooded and damaged displacement tents across Gaza.

articles.headline: Russian drone and missile strikes cause widespread blackouts across Ukraine
articles.title: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
articles.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky reported that overnight Russian missile and drone attacks damaged energy infrastructure across 12 Ukrainian regions, leaving the capital Kyiv facing severe power, water, and heating disruptions. The bombardment involved over 30 ballistic missiles and 170 drones, injuring nine people. These strikes occurred ahead of upcoming trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi and followed a recent humanitarian evacuation in Oleshky.
articles.description: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.

articles.headline: New report reveals artificial intelligence is accelerating Anthropic research development
articles.title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
articles.summary: A report published Thursday by the artificial intelligence safety research organization METR revealed that Anthropic models are improving twice as fast as last year largely due to artificial intelligence assistance. The findings highlight significant productivity gains among employees using unreleased internal models. However, researchers noted that Anthropic heavily redacted the public report to protect sensitive competitive information from rivals.
articles.description: Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful AI. And it appears to be working remarkably well, with the company's models improving roughly twice as quickly as a year ago, with little indication of slowing down. That's according to a new report published Thursday by the AI safety research organization METR, following an 11-week investigation […]

articles.headline: India’s night lights up for Diwali
articles.title: India’s night lights up for Diwali
articles.description: India is celebrating Diwali with prayers, lights and fireworks marking one of the country's biggest Hindu festivals.

articles.headline: Tankers carrying Russian diesel change course amid ongoing US trader hesitation
articles.title: Why are oil traders refusing to buy Russian diesel after Trump-Putin deal?
articles.summary: At least three tankers carrying Russian diesel have altered their destinations away from the United States following a temporary sanctions exemption agreed between President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin in October. Traders remain hesitant to purchase the fuel due to continued congressional bans and legal risks. While Moscow insists the trade will proceed, experts state the initial shipments will provide minimal relief to high American fuel prices.
articles.description: Zero Russian diesel has reached the US as tankers divert and buyers fear legal action.

articles.headline: Dozens killed in Yemen market strike as government offensive against Houthis continues
articles.title: Dozens killed as humanitarian crisis mounts in Yemen: What next for war?
articles.summary: A missile strike killed dozens of people at a market in the Taiz governorate on Friday, with Yemen's internationally recognized government and the Houthi movement blaming each other for the attack. The violence coincides with an ongoing month-long military offensive launched by the Presidential Leadership Council to reclaim territory. The protracted conflict has displaced hundreds of thousands of people and deepened a severe humanitarian crisis across the nation.
articles.description: Government forces reclaim key territories in Taiz and Lahij but face setbacks under Houthi resistance in certain areas.

articles.headline: Mexican mayor Miguel Angel Almaraz freed after hours-long abduction in Zacatecas
articles.title: Mexican mayor found alive after hours-long abduction
articles.summary: Federal officials confirmed that Rio Bravo Mayor Miguel Angel Almaraz was released unharmed on Sunday, following an abduction by armed men in northern Mexico. Almaraz was traveling with relatives on Saturday when his vehicle was intercepted in a region between Zacatecas and San Luis Potosi states. Authorities stated an investigation is ongoing to determine the motive and culprits behind the kidnapping.
articles.description: Rio Bravo mayor freed by captors after being abducted in Zacatecas state, known for cartel-linked violence.

articles.headline: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz to nominate Ilse Aigner for president
articles.title: Chancellor Merz to nominate Aigner as Germany’s first woman president
articles.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz announced plans to nominate Bavarian politician Ilse Aigner to succeed Frank-Walter Steinmeier as the country's next president. Aigner, speaker of the Bavarian state parliament, would become Germany's first female head of state if confirmed. The Federal Convention will vote on January 30 to choose a successor for Steinmeier, who reaches his term limit in March 2027.
articles.description: Ilse Aigner, speaker of the Bavarian state parliament, belongs to the Christian Social Union in Bavaria (CSU) party.

articles.headline: Winter storm floods tens of thousands of displaced families' tents in Gaza
articles.title: Rains flood 70,000 displaced families’ tents in Gaza
articles.summary: Heavy rainfall from the first winter storm of the season flooded approximately 70,000 tents sheltering displaced Palestinians in the Gaza Strip within 12 hours. According to Gaza's Government Media Office, the disaster caused initial losses estimated at three million dollars, collapsed walls, and triggered about 1,500 distress calls. Officials blamed Israeli restrictions on shelter materials for blocking reconstruction efforts.
articles.description: Initial losses are estimated at about $3m, according to Gaza's Government Media Office.

articles.headline: New Zealand election remains too close to call
articles.title: New Zealand vote still too close to call as results trickle in
articles.summary: New Zealand's general election on November 7, 2026, remained tightly contested as early vote counts showed Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's National Party and the opposition Labour Party neck-and-neck. With neither party projected to win an outright majority, attention turned to minor factions like the centrist Opportunity Party. Voters faced rising living costs and economic pressures driven by global fuel shocks.
articles.description: New Zealand’s election remained too close to call on November 7, as early results trickled in from across the country, with neither the governing National-Luxon coalition nor Labour falling short of a majority and minor parties weighing in, including a rising Opportunity Party

articles.headline: Sonia Gandhi discusses new memoir and political history in interview
articles.title: Sonia Gandhi interview: ‘Great damage done to the fabric of India by BJP’
articles.summary: In an interview with The Hindu regarding her forthcoming book Belonging: A Journey of Love published by HarperCollins India, senior Indian National Congress politician Sonia Gandhi answered questions from N. Ram about her life, the Emergency, and Indian politics. Gandhi reflected on her decades in India, her relationship with Rajiv Gandhi and Indira Gandhi, and her decision to author her own story.
articles.description: Ahead of the launch of her book, Sonia Gandhi speaks to The Hindu, answering a number of questions — personal and political

articles.headline: Sudan child malnutrition crisis deepens amid civil war and drought
articles.title: Sudan war and climate change see parents struggle to feed their children
articles.summary: Severe acute malnutrition is threatening hundreds of thousands of young children across Sudan due to ongoing civil war, displacement, and drought. Medical personnel at facilities like Port Sudan Teaching Hospital report extreme overcrowding and financial strains. According to the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification, hundreds of thousands of children under five are expected to suffer from severe acute malnutrition in 2026, while conflict zones like Darfur and Blue Nile State face worsening humanitarian conditions and inadequate aid.
articles.description: War, poverty and climate change are all affecting Sudanese, with increasing cases of child malnutrition.

articles.title: 'I treat all these people like they are victims', says doctor who treated Krakow shooting suspect
articles.description: Two doctors were eating near the Polish city's Main Market Square when a gunman began firing at random.

articles.headline: Donald Trump offers White House press secretary role to UFC chief Dana White
articles.title: Why Trump joked about having Dana White as his White House press secretary
articles.summary: Ultimate Fighting Championship chief executive Dana White is scheduled to meet United States President Donald Trump in Washington to discuss the vacant White House press secretary position. President Trump announced the proposal on Truth Social following recent Republican Party midterm losses. White confirmed the upcoming discussion while highlighting his current professional responsibilities. The administration previously saw departures from Karoline Leavitt and Katie Zacharia.
articles.description: The two have business ties going back decades, and White has helped Trump reach out to younger voters.

articles.headline: State security forces restrict access to proposed Siang dam site
articles.title: The Siang dam and a threatened homeland
articles.summary: Central security forces and State police have deployed barricades and concertina wires near Parong village in Arunachal Pradesh to restrict unauthorized access to the Siang river. Parong in Siang district is one of three proposed locations identified for a Pre-Feasibility Report regarding the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project developed by the National Hydroelectric Power Corporation.
articles.description: The Adi community has been protesting against the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh, saying it threatens their land, livelihoods, and civilisation. The agitation has turned violent in response to increasing use of force by the State authorities. The community alleges that the State government has used deceit, force, and threats to get consent for the feasibility study. Abhinay Lakshman reports on the resistance

articles.headline: Paraguayan President Santiago Pena resigns amid violent banking protests
articles.title: After Donald Trump’s midterm poll rout, South America breathes easy as far-right feels the heat
articles.summary: Hundreds of thousands of protesters flooded the streets of Asuncion on November 4, 2026, after being locked out of their accounts at the countrys largest bank, prompting President Santiago Pena to resign. As Congress moved to impeach him, Senator Antonio Velazquez stated on November 5 that Pena had disappeared and likely fled to Argentina to seek asylum following the unrest.
articles.description: Just a day after a blue wave swept across the U.S. in midterms election shaking President Donald Trump’s administration, the fall of Santiago Pena carries significance beyond the borders of the country of seven million people

articles.headline: US president Donald Trump weighs military options amid escalating tensions with Iran
articles.title: Will Trump strike nuclear sites again as Iran engages ‘cognitive warfare’?
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump is facing political pressure and mixed diplomatic signals regarding the conflict with Iran following midterms. According to media reports, United States forces conducted minor strikes on Qeshm Island while Iranian health officials distributed iodine tablets near nuclear facilities. Observers note that leadership in Washington is evaluating potential military actions and upcoming decisions before January.
articles.description: The US president has been sending mixed messages after his party suffered a defeat at the midterm elections.

articles.headline: Democrats capture full control of U.S. Congress in midterms
articles.title: U.S. midterm election results: Senate, House and Governor shifts before and after
articles.summary: The November 2026 U.S. midterm elections resulted in a dramatic shift as Democrats secured majorities in both the Senate and the House of Representatives, crossing the 218-seat threshold in the lower chamber. Driven by voter discontent over economic pressures and living costs, the results contrasted sharply with the 2022 midterms. Several candidates achieved historic firsts, including Abdul El-Sayed entering the Senate as the first Muslim member.
articles.description: Democrats surged to full control of Congress in the November 2026 U.S. midterm elections, flipping the Senate and House after winning net seats across key battlegrounds and sweeping into Republican strongholds. Here’s what changed between 2022 and 2026 midterms.

articles.headline: Apple accelerates Siri AI roadmap to match industry rivals
articles.title: Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic
articles.summary: According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple Chief Executive Officer John Ternus is urging artificial intelligence leader Craig Federighi to quicken development on a powerful virtual assistant. Upcoming software updates will introduce fine-grained control over first-party applications and third-party integrations. Furthermore, the company aims to develop autonomous capabilities allowing the assistant to track goals and handle ongoing multi-step tasks by next year.
articles.description: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says CEO John Ternus is pressuring AI czar Craig Federighi to accelerate the Siri roadmap and deliver a powerful AI agent that can compete with OpenAI's Dots or Meta's Muse. articles.headline: Manchester United secure dramatic draw against Aston Villa
articles.title: Man United earn 4-4 draw against Aston Villa but remain in relegation zone
articles.summary: Manchester United secured a four-all draw against Aston Villa at Old Trafford on Sunday after scoring two stoppage-time goals. Despite the late comeback, the Premier League club remains in eighteenth place with eight points from ten matches under manager Michael Carrick. In other league fixtures, Chelsea suffered a defeat against Sunderland while Liverpool defeated Crystal Palace three to one.
articles.description: Michael Carrick's team continue forgettable season with last-gasp draw at Old Trafford in front of angry home fans.

articles.summary: United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer held a conference call with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng on November 6, 2026, to discuss bilateral economic commitments ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. While Washington pressed Beijing to immediately implement prior agreements, Beijing voiced concerns over recent American trade restrictions and sanctions.
articles.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer held a call with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng and discussed economic and trade commitments over the last year

articles.headline: Carlos Alcaraz defeats Ben Shelton to claim Paris Masters title
articles.title: Carlos Alcaraz beats Ben Shelton to win Paris Masters tennis title
articles.summary: Spanish tennis player Carlos Alcaraz defeated American Ben Shelton 7-6, 7-5 in the Paris Masters final on Sunday. The victory marks his ninth 1000-level title and his fifth tour-level win of the year. Alcaraz triumphed after nearly two hours of play, having previously saved match points against Taylor Fritz in the quarterfinals. Shelton, ranked fourth globally, experienced his first defeat in a Masters final.
articles.description: Alcaraz bagged a 7-6 (7/5), 7-5 straight sets for an elusive Paris crown before the year-end ATP Finals.

articles.headline: Former Keralam Excise Commissioner alleges corruption against senior officials
articles.title: Ex-Keralam Excise Commissioner flags corruption, bribery in report to govt; CPI(M) alleges Minister’s involvement
articles.summary: Former Keralam Excise Commissioner Seeram Sambasiva Rao submitted a report to the State government alleging that two senior officials engaged in bribery and corruption involving bar owners. The report, submitted on November 6, 2026, recommended a Vigilance inquiry and prompted the Communist Party of India Marxist to question Excise Minister M. Liju over potential links.
articles.description: In report submitted to State government shortly before being relieved from the post, Seeram Sambasiva Rao mentions that Excise Minister M. Liju was acquainted with one of the bar owners allegedly involved in the transactions

articles.headline: New Zealand governing National Party leads in early general election results
articles.title: Two main parties neck and neck after New Zealand vote, near complete count
articles.summary: New Zealand's centre-right National Party secured 31.19 percent of the vote in early results, ahead of the opposition Labour Party at 28.35 percent. Polling stations closed following a mixed-member proportional election held on Saturday, with the Electoral Commission aiming to release preliminary outcomes from 95 percent of polling stations by the end of the evening.
articles.description: New Zealand's National and Labour parties secure just short of 30 percent of the popular vote.

articles.headline: Delhi air quality remains very poor as schools shift to hybrid mode
articles.title: Delhi air ‘very poor’ with AQI reading of 364
articles.summary: Delhi recorded a very poor air quality index reading of 364 on November 7, 2026, prompting authorities to implement Stage III measures under the Graded Response Action Plan. In response to the worsening pollution, the Delhi Directorate of Education directed all schools to conduct classes up to class 5 in hybrid mode starting immediately.
articles.description: The Delhi Directorate of Education has directed all government and private schools to conduct classes up to class 5 in hybrid mode in view of worsening air quality in the national capital

articles.headline: Tens of thousands protest in Amsterdam demanding action on Gaza
articles.title: Tens of thousands march in Amsterdam, pressing Dutch government on Gaza, Israel
articles.summary: More than 200,000 demonstrators marched through Amsterdam on November 8, 2026, urging the Dutch government to implement stricter trade sanctions, halt arms sales, and formally declare Israel's Gaza campaign as genocide. Organised by groups including Amnesty International, the protest highlighted public discontent over the conflict. Prime Minister Rob Jetten defended his administration's diplomatic efforts, citing ongoing political pressure to alleviate the humanitarian crisis.
articles.description: Organisers of the “Red Line” demonstration called for stricter trade sanctions, a halt to arms sales, and an official declaration that Israel’s actions in Gaza amount to genocide

articles.headline: Demonstrators fill Amsterdam streets to protest Israeli military actions
articles.title: Hundreds of thousands join Amsterdam’s ‘Red Line’ protest against Israel
articles.summary: Thousands of individuals gathered in Amsterdam on Sunday for a Red Line demonstration, demanding that authorities enforce stricter trade restrictions on Israel and halt arms sales. Amnesty International reported that over 200,000 participants joined the march. Protesters criticized the Dutch government for perceived inaction regarding the conflict in Gaza, which has resulted in at least 74,000 Palestinian deaths since October 2023, according to reports.
articles.description: Protesters seek stricter trade restrictions on Israel and a halt to all arms sales.

articles.headline: Democrats plan congressional probes targeting Elon Musk and Stephen Miller
articles.title: Democrats eye Musk, Miller probes after midterm rout
