articles.summary: Incoming Democratic congressional leaders announced plans on November 8, 2026, to investigate tech billionaire Elon Musk and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller following the party's midterm victories. Representative Robert Garcia stated that upcoming hearings will examine Mr. Musk's involvement in federal layoffs and Mr. Miller's hardline immigration policies. Meanwhile, Democratic leaders also expressed support for initiating impeachment proceedings against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
articles.description: California Representative Robert Garcia ‌said investigations will focus on Musk's involvement in the Department of Government Efficiency's firing of federal workers last year, and Miller's role in Trump's ‌hardline immigration crackdown

articles.headline: Elvis and Eminem rights holders file lawsuits against AI music firm Suno
articles.title: Elvis and Eminem rights holders are suing Suno
articles.summary: Representatives for Elvis Presley's estate and publishers of Eminem's music filed lawsuits against artificial intelligence firm Suno. The legal complaints allege that the company unlawfully generates soundalikes and lyrics mimicking iconic performers. Lawyers representing the Presley estate claim violations of Tennessee's ELVIS Act. Suno spokesperson Cat McCormack stated that the platform prohibits unauthorized artist replications and utilizes screening tools to prevent misuse.
articles.description: Suno is facing yet another pair of lawsuits. A group of rights holders of Elvis Presley's music and the publisher of some of Eminem's biggest records are suing the AI music company, claiming it illegally generates music and lyrics that mimic those artists. The lawyers in the Presley suit claim that Suno has violated Tennessee's […]

articles.headline: Israeli President Isaac Herzog faces key choice on government formation
articles.title: President Herzog faces key choice as Israel struggles to form government
articles.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog must select a politician to form a new government following an inconclusive election where neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor rival Gadi Eisenkot secured a parliamentary majority. Although Eisenkot received sixty-seven endorsements from lawmakers, forming a stable coalition remains challenging due to mutual vetoes, uncooperative ultra-Orthodox parties, and ongoing disputes involving Arab-led factions.
articles.description: Eisenkot's bloc and Arab-led parties seek to oust Netanyahu, but failure to form government could leave him in power.

articles.headline: United States military offers reward for information on Iran nuclear program
articles.title: United States offers $20 million reward for information on 'Iran's nuclear program': CENTCOM
articles.summary: The United States Central Command announced a financial reward of up to twenty million dollars through the Rewards for Justice program for details regarding Iran's nuclear facilities, equipment, and personnel. While President Donald Trump stated that Tehran is eager to negotiate an end to the ongoing conflict, the State Department cited persistent noncompliance with International Atomic Energy Agency safeguards as justification.
articles.description: U.S. State Department program, Rewards for Justice, gave no specific parameters on what information would yield a $20 million reward

articles.headline: Russian missile attack on Kyiv injures residents and damages buildings
articles.title: Russia launches missile attack on Kyiv, injuring residents
articles.summary: Russian ballistic missiles struck residential and kindergarten buildings in Kyiv, injuring two individuals according to city officials and Mayor Vitali Klitschko. The assault followed warnings from President Volodymyr Zelenskyy regarding escalating threats to Ukrainian infrastructure, occurring simultaneously as diplomatic delegations prepare for upcoming United States-led negotiations in Abu Dhabi.
articles.description: Air strikes damage buildings and injure two civilians after Zelenskyy warns of potential for new attacks.

articles.headline: Indian youth movement demands political accountability and fair elections
articles.title: India’s ‘cockroach’ movement seeks to restore culture of accountability
articles.summary: Founded by Abhijeet Dipke, the Cockroach Janta Party mobilized thousands in May to protest exam leaks, unemployment, and living costs, leading to the education minister's resignation. Protesters now target the chief election commissioner, accusing the election body of voter list manipulation favoring Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party, which denies the allegations and accuses demonstrators of undermining democracy.
articles.description: India's Cockroach Janta Party is a youth movement demanding political accountability, employment and fair elections.

articles.headline: Israeli authorities release Palestinian journalist Abed Abou Shhadeh after five days
articles.title: Israeli forces release Palestinian journalist Abou Shhadeh
articles.summary: Israeli authorities released Palestinian journalist Abed Abou Shhadeh without charge after a five-day detention at a Shin Bet facility in Petah Tikva. Defence team members from the legal rights group Adalah stated that the arrest aimed to intimidate Arab society and delegitimise Palestinian votes, noting police lacked evidence for suspicions regarding foreign contact.
articles.description: Abed Abou Shhadeh says his detention was part of Israel's political measures 'to intimidate Arab society as a whole'.

articles.headline: Los Angeles reacts to historic mayoral election
articles.title: Los Angeles reacts to historic mayoral election
articles.description: Los Angeles reacts to historic mayoral election

articles.headline: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt
articles.title: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt
articles.description: At least seven people died when two trains collided, causing several carriages to derail and fall down an embankment.

articles.headline: Police recover two more bodies near Chamundi Hills in Mysuru murder case
articles.title: Rajajinagar murders: Two more bodies recovered near Chamundi hills in Mysuru
articles.summary: Rajajinagar Police recovered two bodies, suspected to be Shivakumar and Divya, near Chamundi Hills in Mysuru during an investigation into the murders of seven family members. Five bodies have been found so far. The accused, Indushekhar, allegedly dumped relatives' remains across multiple locations over 15 days and remains in police custody.
articles.description: With this development, five bodies have been traced so far in the case, while the search for the remaining two continues

articles.headline: Egyptian embassy reopens in Libya for the first time in 12 years
articles.title: Egyptian embassy reopens in Libya for the first time in 12 years
articles.description: Egypt has reopened its embassy in Libya’s capital, Tripoli, after a 12-year closure.

articles.headline: British Hindu family files High Court lawsuit over school tilak objection
articles.title: UK Hindu family takes legal action after school objects to boy wearing tilak
articles.summary: Parents of a nine-year-old boy in London have initiated legal proceedings in the High Court seeking 25,000 pounds in damages after withdrawing their child from Vicar’s Green Primary School. The dispute began when staff objected to the student wearing a religious marking called the Tilak-Chandlo. The legal firm Ashray Law filed the claim alleging religious discrimination and rights breaches, while the school maintained it acted sensitively and offered alternative arrangements.
articles.description: The parents of a nine-year-old boy have approached the UK High Court, alleging religious discrimination after he was prevented from wearing the sacred Tilak-Chandlo to school

articles.headline: Voters overwhelmingly reject data centre developments across the United States
articles.title: How the US midterm elections reflected resistance to data centres
articles.summary: Data from election monitoring projects showed that citizens voted to reject new data centre construction in 40 out of 41 ballot measures during the November 2026 midterm elections. The widespread public opposition reflected growing bipartisan concerns regarding soaring electricity bills, water scarcity tied to artificial intelligence infrastructure, and economic stability.
articles.description: Voters rejected data centre development in all but one of the 41 measures addressing the issue in Tuesday's midterms.

articles.headline: Turkish and Azerbaijani presidents reaffirm alliance following recent diplomatic tensions
articles.title: Turkey, Azerbaijan leaders vow unity after tensions
articles.summary: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev met in the Fuzuli district on November 8, 2026, to declare their bilateral partnership solid. The leaders sought to overcome a public rift that erupted in September after Baku banned Islamic headscarves in classrooms and declared several Turkish nationals persona non grata. Analysts noted the friction also reflected broader disagreements regarding Azerbaijan's diplomatic independence and relations with Israel.
articles.description: The Turkic-speaking allies describe their relationship as "one nation, two states" and, despite the friction, remain closely bound by military and energy ties

articles.headline: China confirms discussions are underway for a trilateral meeting involving Xi, Trump and Putin
articles.title: China says discussions underway on Xi-Trump-Putin meeting
articles.summary: Chinese officials confirmed talks are happening regarding a potential historic gathering between Chinese President Xi Jinping, U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin. The meeting could occur this month on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, though analysts suggest the discussion may yield few substantive outcomes due to conflicting national interests.
articles.description: President Trump is expected to travel to Shenzhen to meet President Xi for the third time this year, as the fragile trade truce is set to expire in January

articles.headline: Palestinian journalist Abed Abou Shhadeh released after 5 days in detention
articles.title: Palestinian journalist Abed Abou Shhadeh released after 5 days in detention
articles.description: Palestinian journalist Abed Abou Shhadeh released after 5 days detention

articles.headline: Millions across India celebrate Diwali amid air pollution concerns
articles.title: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali
articles.summary: Millions of people across India celebrated Diwali on November 6, 2026, illuminating homes and temples while facing severe air pollution challenges. Delhi recorded a very poor air quality index of 391. The Supreme Court permitted the limited use of green firecrackers, though critics questioned their effectiveness as communities gathered for traditional prayers, sweets, and family festivities.
articles.description: Millions of Indians are marking the festival of lights with glowing lamps, fireworks and traditional sweets.

articles.headline: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reports over 5,000 measles cases in 2026
articles.title: CDC reports more than 5,000 measles cases, highest number in 35 years
articles.summary: The United States recorded 5,182 confirmed measles cases in 2026, marking the highest total since 1991 according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Children under nineteen account for fifty-nine percent of infections amid declining kindergarten vaccination rates. Meanwhile, a dispute emerged between federal officials and Pennsylvania authorities regarding national death toll classifications.
articles.description: Children and teenagers make up almost 60 percent of confirmed cases.

articles.headline: Assam oil facility fire death toll rises as four employees suspended
articles.title: Assam OIL facility fire: death toll rises to four as another injured dies; four suspended
articles.summary: The death toll from an explosion and fire at an Oil India Limited facility in Assam's Dibrugarh district reached four after an injured worker succumbed to injuries. The public sector undertaking suspended four personnel in charge of the site and instituted a high-level inquiry. Officials announced financial compensation for the families of the deceased and injured victims.
articles.description: OIL has instituted a high-level inquiry to probe into the incident

articles.headline: India and EU conclude negotiations on 93.5 billion euro innovation programme
articles.title: India, EU conclude multi-billion Euro global innovation programme
articles.summary: India and the European Union concluded negotiations on New Delhi's association with the Horizon Europe programme, carrying a budget of 93.5 billion euro. The European Commission stated the move will strengthen scientific cooperation and create collaboration opportunities. According to the European Union, researchers in India will receive direct funding upon signing the formal agreement, which is anticipated in January.
articles.description: India’s association with the Horizon programme is seen as part of the comprehensive strategic agenda of the two sides for the next five years

articles.headline: Pakistan defeats India by three wickets in U-19 Asia Cup
articles.title: Pakistan beat India by three wickets in U-19 Asia Cup
articles.summary: Pakistan secured a three-wicket victory against India during their men's under-nineteen Asia Cup fixture in Oman. India was bowled out for two hundred eight runs before Pakistan successfully chased the target, led by an unbeaten century from Hamza Zahoor. Arjun Rajput had earlier top-scored for the Indian side with an aggressive century during the match.
articles.description: India were bowled out for a modest 208 and Pakistan, after a top-order wobble, managed to complete the chase, with Hamza Zahoor taking the team home with an excellent, unbeaten 100 off 108 balls after coming in at number seven

articles.headline: Prime minister Narendra Modi celebrates Deepavali with security personnel in Bastar.
articles.title: ‘Dimagi Naxals’ instigating people against Constitution: PM Modi as Maoists eliminated
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi celebrated Deepavali on November 8, 2026, with security forces in Chhattisgarh's Bastar region. Central Armed Police Forces and Chhattisgarh Police personnel were deployed for anti-Maoist operations in the area. The government announced on March 31, 2026, that the country was free from Maoism following the elimination of leaders and surrender of cadres, allowing development to flourish in the formerly troubled territory.
articles.description: Celebrating Diwali with CRPF personnel in Bastar, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said the country must “identify and defeat” ideological supporters of Naxalism who have “infiltrated” parties and organisations

articles.headline: Egypt reopens Tripoli embassy in major diplomatic shift on Libya
articles.title: Egypt’s reopening of its embassy in Tripoli signals regional shift on Libya
articles.summary: Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty inaugurated the Egyptian embassy in Tripoli after a twelve-year closure, signaling a regional policy shift. Analysts noted that Cairo is broadening diplomatic engagement beyond eastern factions led by Khalifa Haftar. The diplomatic visit also addressed economic cooperation, reconstruction opportunities, and maritime border memorandums involving Turkey.
articles.description: Former rivals in Libya are pushing for a unity government to end years of conflict.

articles.headline: Iran reviews Qatari proposals aimed at addressing differences over nuclear programme
articles.title: Iran reviewing proposals on Tehran’s nuclear programme: Officials
articles.summary: Iranian officials stated that Tehran is reviewing proposals from Qatari mediators addressing differences with the United States regarding its nuclear programme. The diplomatic engagement follows United States midterm elections and ongoing conflict. According to officials, potential trust-building measures involve lifting United States blockades and releasing frozen funds in exchange for International Atomic Energy Agency inspections and reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
articles.description: Mediators and Iran have discussed a potential bridge deal aimed at helping pave the way for further talks on Tehran’s nuclear programme, according to regional officials

articles.headline: CCTV captures streets shaking as 5.7-magnitude earthquake hits Japan
articles.title: CCTV captures streets shaking as 5.7-magnitude earthquake hits Japan
articles.description: A 5.7-magnitude earthquake struck central Japan, injuring more than 20 people.

articles.headline: Pedro Alliana sworn in as Paraguay president following impeachment
articles.title: Paraguay’s Santiago Pena under arrest, new president Pedro Alliana sworn in
articles.summary: Pedro Alliana took the oath of office as Paraguay's 53rd president after 44 senators voted to impeach his predecessor, Santiago Pena. The political crisis erupted following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left millions of clients without access to funds. Prosecutors are now seeking the arrest of Pena on suspicion of breaching the public trust.
articles.description: The sudden leadership change comes as Paraguay reels from the collapse of the Ueno Bank, a popular lender.

articles.headline: South Africa ruling party suffers major setback in municipal election results
articles.title: South Africa’s ANC suffers setback in local elections
articles.summary: South Africa's African National Congress secured thirty-one percent of the national vote in municipal elections, dropping fourteen percentage points from 2021. President Cyril Ramaphosa's party failed to win an outright majority in any of the eight major metro areas, forcing officials into difficult coalition negotiations. Secretary-General Fikile Mbalula described the electoral outcome as catastrophic following widespread voter frustration regarding unemployment and basic services.
articles.description: With 99 percent of votes counted, President Cyril Ramaphosa's party wins 31 percent nationally.

articles.headline: Congress party criticizes Prime Minister Narendra Modi over 2016 demonetization anniversary
articles.title: 'Notebandi' devastated economy, 'votebandi' destroying polity: Congress slams PM Modi
articles.summary: The Indian National Congress criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi on November 8, 2026, marking the tenth anniversary of the 2016 demonetization policy. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh stated on social media that the withdrawal of high-value currency notes devastated the economy and harmed the national polity, echoing long-standing opposition criticism of the federal government's economic decisions.
articles.description: On this day in 2016, Prime Minister Modi addressed the nation and announced demonetisation of high-value currency notes of ₹500 and ₹1,000

articles.headline: Slain anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota cremated in Mansa
articles.title: Punjab anti-drug activist Jhota cremated in his native place Mansa
articles.summary: The mortal remains of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota were brought to his native Mansa for cremation on November 8, 2026, following a post-mortem at PGIMER in Chandigarh. Jhota was shot dead on October 13 during a Facebook Live session. His family and the joint action committee concluded a 22-day protest after the Punjab government agreed to transfer the investigation to the Central Bureau of Investigation and meet several demands.
articles.description: Jhota was shot dead in broad daylight at a medical store in a busy marketplace in Mansa town on October 13

articles.headline: Taiwan detains Communist Party leader over alleged Chinese sponsorship in election
articles.title: Taiwan detains Communist Party leader over alleged Chinese sponsorship in election
articles.summary: Taiwanese authorities detained Taiwan People's Communist Party chair Lin Te-wang on Sunday over allegations of running for borough chief under Chinese Communist Party direction and sponsorship. Prosecutors alleged Mr Lin sought to buy votes by recruiting voters for trips to mainland China ahead of local elections scheduled for November 28, 2026, leading courts to approve his detention.
articles.description: Prosecutors also alleged that Mr. Lin sought to buy votes by repeatedly recruiting voters to travel to mainland China, where they received hospitality, the report said.

articles.headline: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot tasked with forming new government
articles.title: Will Eisenkot be able to form Israel’s next gov’t amid divided opposition?
articles.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog tasked Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new administration after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition lost its parliamentary majority following October elections. Eisenkot faces significant hurdles uniting a divided opposition and securing the necessary sixty-one seats in the Knesset without relying on controversial external support from Arab-led parties.
articles.description: Former army chief has 28 days to cobble together a ruling coalition after President chose him over incumbent Netanyahu.

articles.headline: European Union orders TikTok to modify algorithm
articles.title: EU tells TikTok to fix ‘harmful’ For You feed, threatens fines
articles.summary: The European Commission ordered TikTok to alter the algorithm powering its For You feed, warning the social media platform of potential fines of up to 6 percent. Brussels accused the company of violating the Digital Services Act by exposing users to harmful rabbit holes of triggering content. TikTok rejected the findings as fundamentally inaccurate regarding its architecture.
articles.description: TikTok's algorithm 'leading users down rabbit holes they cannot easily escape from', European Commission says.

articles.headline: Trump replaces chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller
articles.title: With Stephen Miller pick, Trump readies for a battle
articles.summary: Donald Trump has appointed his longtime adviser and political operative Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles following the Republican Party midterm election defeats. Miller is known for his hardline immigration policies and aggressive rhetoric, drawing sharp condemnation from Democrats and some Republicans. His elevation to the influential post signals a potential political battle with Congress rather than an olive branch, raising questions about future legislative negotiations and oversight.
articles.description: The US president's promotion of Miller, a loyal partisan firebrand to be his new chief of staff sets up likely clashes with Congress.

articles.headline: Paraguayan senators vote to impeach President Santiago Pena
articles.title: Paraguayan President Pena impeached over banking crisis
articles.summary: Paraguayan senators voted 44 to zero to impeach President Santiago Pena following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which locked roughly three million citizens out of their accounts. Lawmakers rejected his resignation offer to strip him of presidential immunity. Vice President Pedro Alliana was subsequently sworn in to complete the remaining mandate until 2028.
articles.description: Santiago Pena had offered his resignation over the disaster, but lawmakers pressed ahead with impeachment proceedings that would strip him of immunity granted to former Presidents

articles.headline: China intelligence agency recruits executive to spy on Nvidia
articles.title: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
articles.summary: According to The New York Times, China's Ministry of State Security recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to gather intelligence on Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang. The operation aimed to obtain information regarding American artificial intelligence chips and influence the company regarding market access. Three United States House committees subsequently asked Jensen Huang to appear for a briefing.
articles.description: China's intelligence agency recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to The New York Times. The Ministry of State Security (MSS) enlisted her to glean information about American AI chips and "potentially influence the company to push for its most advanced chips to be made available to China." Megaspeed […]

articles.headline: US urges China to honour commitments under Busan trade agreement
articles.title: US urges China to honour Busan trade deal commitments
articles.summary: United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and United States Trade Representative Jamieson Greer met Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng to demand the immediate implementation of the Busan trade agreement. The United States Department of the Treasury announced the discussions on Friday, emphasizing that progress depends on concrete results regarding tariff reductions and agricultural purchases.
articles.description: Trump-Xi Busan deal aimed to ease tariffs and tech restrictions; progress hinges on China's fulfilment of commitments.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi becomes first player to win back-to-back MLS Golden Boot awards
articles.title: Messi becomes first player to win back-to-back MLS Golden Boot awards
articles.summary: Inter Miami forward Lionel Messi secured consecutive Major League Soccer Golden Boot awards after finishing the regular season with twenty-six goals. Miami drew three-three against Charlotte on Saturday, securing home advantage for the opening playoff rounds. Nashville broke the all-time points record with seventy-seven points, while the upcoming playoffs begin on November nineteen with matchups including Inter Miami against Columbus.
articles.description: The Argentinian scored 26 goals in regular season, topping the charts and leading Inter Miami to the MLS Cup playoffs.

articles.headline: Senior U.S. Justice Department officials resign following midterm elections
articles.title: Wave of resignations from U.S. Justice Department after midterms
articles.summary: Several high-ranking United States Justice Department officials have resigned, including civil rights chief Harmeet Dhillon and national security prosecutor John Eisenberg. Attorney General Todd Blanche announced the departures on Thursday and Friday, following midterm elections that resulted in heavy defeats for President Donald Trump’s Republican Party. Dhillon previously sought voter registration lists across approximately 30 states while Eisenberg and Jason Reding Quinones oversaw investigations into perceived political opponents.
articles.description: The Justice Department under Donald Trump has pursued cases against a number of perceived enemies, and several prosecutors have lost their jobs over their reluctance or inability to bring charges

articles.headline: Bangladesh requests India to extradite ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina
articles.title: Bangladesh Law Minister calls Hasina ‘convicted criminal’, says extradition request sent to India
articles.summary: Bangladesh Law Minister Md Asaduzzaman described ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina as a convicted criminal and confirmed that Dhaka has requested her extradition from India under their existing bilateral treaty. Ms Hasina fled to India in August 2024 following a mass uprising and was subsequently sentenced to death and life imprisonment by the International Crimes Tribunal in November 2025.
articles.description: Indian govt previously acknowledged receiving Bangladesh's extradition requests for Ms. Hasina but has not announced any decision on handing her over

articles.headline: Migrant boat sinks off Senegal, killing at least 21 people
articles.title: Migrant boat sinks off Senegal, 21 killed: authorities
articles.summary: A migrant boat sank off the northwestern coast of Senegal on Saturday, resulting in at least twenty-one deaths along the dangerous Atlantic Ocean route toward Europe. The Senegalese Interior Ministry stated that the casualty toll remains provisional while emergency responders successfully rescued one individual from the stricken vessel during ongoing recovery operations.
articles.description: The Senegalese Interior Ministry said in a statement that the death toll from the sinking, which occurred on Saturday (November 7, 2026), was "provisional"

articles.headline: Six people killed and several injured in Krakow shooting
articles.title: How the deadly shooting in Krakow unfolded
articles.summary: Six individuals were killed and multiple others injured when a gunman opened fire in central Krakow on Saturday. Poland's interior minister stated the twenty-five-year-old Polish suspect was inspired by far-right ideologies, while Prime Minister Donald Tusk confirmed that three additional bodies were subsequently discovered during searches of the suspect's residence by law enforcement authorities.
articles.description: Video authenticated by BBC Verify shows the moment gunshots rang out in Krakow's main market square.

articles.headline: Stephen Miller appointed as White House chief of staff by Donald Trump
articles.title: Who is Stephen Miller, Trump’s new White House chief of staff?
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump has named his longtime adviser Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff, succeeding Susie Wiles. The appointment follows the Republican Party's midterm setbacks and comes as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress in January. Miller, known for his hardline immigration policies and mass deportation efforts, is set to assume the new position on Monday.
articles.description: Miller has been a close confidant of Trump since 2016 and an architect of the president's hardline immigration policies.

articles.headline: Congress leader Venugopal says anti-CEC agitation will continue until removal
articles.title: Agitation against CEC will go on till he is removed: Venugopal
articles.summary: All India Congress Committee general secretary K.C. Venugopal stated that demonstrations against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar will persist until his dismissal and the reform of India's electoral system. Speaking in Alappuzha, Venugopal announced a nationwide panchayat-level campaign called Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao to address voter roll deletions, adding that the opposition will press the matter during the upcoming parliamentary session.
articles.description: ‘We will withdraw from this agitation only after Gyanesh Kumar is removed from the post and steps are taken to make India's electoral system and processes flawless, impartial and fair,’ said K.C. Venugopal

articles.headline: Former Palestinian prisoners face continuous rearrests and intimidation by Israel
articles.title: Former Palestinian detainees at mercy of Israel amid perpetual detention
articles.summary: Released Palestinian detainees in the occupied West Bank continue to endure frequent military raids, interrogations, and arbitrary detentions by Israeli forces following their liberation. Former prisoners, including Ahmed Abed and Abdullah, report severe disruptions to their livelihoods, ongoing harassment, and constant threats of returning to prison. Advocacy groups note that such actions are part of a broader, persistent campaign of intimidation across the region.
articles.description: Former Palestinian detainees in the West Bank are being repeatedly detained by Israeli forces, affecting their families.

articles.headline: Israeli President tasks Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government
articles.title: The anti-Netanyahu: Can Gadi Eisenkot give the world a different Israel?
articles.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog assigned Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot the task of assembling a government within 28 days after recent elections left no bloc with a majority. Eisenkot, a former military chief of staff, faces complex coalition negotiations involving ultra-Orthodox parties and opposition factions. The incoming leadership must navigate strained United States relations and ongoing regional conflicts.
articles.description: Unpolished and understated, Eisenkot offers a stark contrast to Netanyahu but risks continuing his legacy

articles.headline: Congress party donations fall nearly 75% in 2025-26
articles.title: Congress donations fall nearly 75%, sharpest decline in a decade
articles.summary: The Indian National Congress experienced a sharp financial decline as its receipts from donations exceeding twenty thousand rupees dropped by nearly seventy-five percent to one hundred thirty crore rupees during the financial year. According to Election Commission filings analysed by The Hindu, this represents the steepest annual fall in contributions over a decade. Funding through the Prudent Electoral Trust fell significantly, while the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party collected significantly higher amounts in previous comparable periods.
articles.description: Congress had received ₹517.39 crore in such contributions in 2024-25, according to its 2024-25 contribution report submitted to the Election Commission of India

articles.headline: Electrical faults drive rising residential and hospital fires
articles.title: Dangerous harmonies: Is there a hidden villain in India’s devastating electrical fires?
articles.summary: Authorities attribute a high proportion of fires across Indian cities to electrical faults, overloads, and short circuits amid surging electricity demands and extreme summer temperatures. Municipal fire services in Delhi and Mumbai report that electrical issues dominate incident statistics. Engineering literature and forensic experts highlight that compromised wiring, aging infrastructure, and unmanaged electrical harmonics in modern appliances create hidden ignition risks in residential buildings and healthcare facilities.
articles.description: Electrical causes are predominating in India’s recent fire incidents; while codes and guidelines are covering these increasingly, there are still major gaps such as taking into account harmonic currents put into the system by state-of-the-art electronics equipment

articles.headline: Rajasthan Bharatiya Janata Party MLA Jaswant Yadav dies at 73
articles.title: Rajasthan BJP MLA Jaswant Yadav dies at 73 after prolonged illness
articles.summary: Jaswant Yadav, a four-time legislator and former state cabinet minister representing the Behror constituency, passed away in Jaipur following a prolonged illness. His son announced that the seventy-three-year-old politician died on Sunday morning. Yadav previously served in the Vasundhara Raje-led government from two thousand sixteen to two thousand eighteen and represented Alwar in the Lok Sabha. His death reduces the current strength of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly to one hundred ninety-nine members.
articles.description: Mr. Yadav was a four-time MLA and had also represented Alwar in the Lok Sabha

articles.headline: French protest movement expands across Europe as demonstrations continue
articles.title: Mapping how France’s protest wave spread across Europe
articles.summary: Demonstrations originating over educational conditions in France have broadened into widespread protests concerning the cost of living, low wages, and housing across thirty European nations. Data analyzed by the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data project indicates that thousands of demonstrations occurred across Europe between September and October. In France, authorities deployed thousands of security personnel while unions and government ministries reported differing turnout figures for weekend rallies.
articles.description: More than 1,700 cost-of-living demonstrations have hit 31 European countries since mid-September, led by France.

articles.headline: Danish engineers capture waste heat from artificial intelligence data centres
articles.title: As AI data centres guzzle energy, can we harness their wasted heat?
articles.summary: Engineers in Denmark have successfully utilized liquid cooling technology to capture one hundred percent of the thermal waste generated by a university supercomputer. The system channels excess heat directly into municipal district heating networks to warm local residents in Sonderborg. As global data centre electricity consumption increases significantly, experts suggest that integrating waste heat recovery infrastructure could help mitigate the environmental impact of rapid technological expansion.
articles.description: The rapid development of AI is draining our resources, but engineers have found a way to use heat lost to the air.

articles.headline: Far-right activists disrupt Deepavali event in Seattle with racist placards
articles.title: Conservative activists storm Deepavali celebrations in Seattle
articles.summary: Conservative activists Jake Lang and Thomas Allen disrupted a cultural event at the Seattle Center Armoury on November 7, 2026, displaying racist slogans before being escorted out. The incident drew sharp condemnation from U.S. lawmakers and community leaders, who emphasized that the community must feel safe to celebrate their heritage freely without facing targeted harassment or xenophobic threats.
articles.description: Videos of the storming of the Deepavali celebrations in Seattle went viral on social media.

articles.headline: Voters and politicians push back against expansion of AI data centers
articles.title: All the latest updates on AI data centers
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence data centers face severe political and public backlash following the November 2026 midterms, where voters largely opposed expansion due to environmental and resource concerns. Tech companies are responding by promising greater community engagement and new energy commitments, while newly elected Democratic leaders demand stricter moratoriums and development restrictions.
articles.description: Massive new data centers are the physical foundation for tech companies’ hopes and dreams for AI. But the rush to expand warehouses full of energy-hungry servers has also kicked up fights across the world over their impact on power grids, utility bills, nearby communities, and the environment. Data centers were a major bipartisan issue ahead […]

articles.headline: An Se-young wins Korea Open for eleventh title of the year
articles.title: An wins Korea Open for 11th badminton title of year
articles.summary: Badminton world number one An Se-young defeated Japan's Akane Yamaguchi in Yeosu to secure her eleventh title of the year at her home tournament. The twenty-four-year-old triumphed 21-12, 15-21, 21-16 to extend an unbeaten run stretching back to March, marking her eleventh straight victory over Yamaguchi and her first home win during a dominant international season.
articles.description: The 24-year-old beat Japan’s Akane Yamaguchi 21-12, 15-21, 21-16 in the final in Yeosu to extend an unbeaten run that stretches back to March

articles.headline: Lawrence Bishnoi gang member detained in the United States pending extradition
articles.title: Lawrence Bishnoi gang member Hari Boxer detained in U.S., extradition process underway
articles.summary: Harichand Jat, an alleged member of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang linked to multiple extortion and shooting cases across India, has been detained by United States immigration authorities. Rajasthan Police stated that international coordination involving the Central Bureau of Investigation and Interpol facilitated the detention, and official proceedings to extradite him are underway.
articles.description: The Rajasthan Anti-Gangster Task Force (AGTF) secured the detention through sustained coordination with international agencies, including the CBI and Interpol, police said

articles.headline: Centre mandates nationwide rice and paddy stock declarations amid price rise
articles.title: Amid price rise, Centre mandates rice, paddy stock declaration
articles.summary: The Indian government has directed all traders, wholesalers, retailers, processors, and millers to declare their rice and paddy stocks on the Food Stock Portal every Friday. Issued by the Food Ministry on Thursday, the order aims to combat rising prices driven by a deficient monsoon. Furthermore, the Centre authorized five southern states to impose stock limits until January 2027 while doubling e-auction targets to improve market availability.
articles.description: To prevent hoarding, Union government allows five southern States to impose stock limits

articles.headline: Nithya Raman wins election to become Los Angeles mayor
articles.title: Nithya Raman | The urban planner
articles.summary: Nithya Raman defeated incumbent Mayor Karen Bass to become the mayor-elect of Los Angeles. A city council member since 2020 with a background in urban planning from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Harvard University, Ms. Raman became the first South Asian mayor-elect and the first candidate to defeat a sitting Los Angeles mayor since 2005.
articles.description: Before entering U.S. politics, L.A.’s first South Asian Mayor-elect worked among the urban poor in Chennai, where she used data to expose gaps in slum resettlement and public facilities

articles.headline: Jon Ossoff wins senate reelection defeating Republican Mike Collins
articles.title: Jon Ossoff | Ambition without ambition
articles.summary: Jon Ossoff won the November 3 election against Republican Mike Collins, defeating him to defend his Senate seat in Georgia. Mr. Ossoff became the only incumbent Senate Democrat to win in a state won by President Donald Trump in 2024. The 39-year-old senator has faced ongoing media speculation regarding potential 2028 presidential aspirations, which he has vehemently denied.
articles.description: While headlines scream Ossoff looks more presidential after his Senate win, he remains focused on his State while attacking Donald Trump and his family

articles.headline: Could Trump’s veto stop the Democratic majority?
articles.title: Could Trump’s veto stop the Democratic majority?
articles.description: Democrats have won the House and Senate. AJLabs looks at the numbers and what their majority means for Trump.

articles.headline: Sailor killed in Gulf missile attack as Iran reports burning tankers
articles.title: Sailor killed in Gulf as Iran says tankers on fire
articles.summary: A seafarer aboard the oil tanker Velos Sapphire was killed in a projectile attack in the Gulf on November 5, 2026, according to Velos Tankers. Simultaneously, Iranian state media and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps reported that multiple tankers caught fire after striking mines in the Strait of Hormuz following unauthorized transits.
articles.description: The Marshall Islands-flagged tanker Velos Sapphire was sailing to Bahrain empty of cargo when the attack happened on November 5, Velos Tankers said in a statement

articles.headline: Armed attackers kill thirty-three people in eastern DRC village raid
articles.title: Armed men kill at least 33 in village in Ebola-hit eastern DRC
articles.summary: Suspected Allied Democratic Forces militants raided Cantine village in North Kivu province, killing thirty-three people and burning over fifty houses. The assault forced patients, including individuals linked to an ongoing Ebola outbreak, to flee the local health facility. Local civil society leaders criticized the security forces for failing to prevent the violence.
articles.description: Locals blame ADF armed group, which pledged allegiance to ISIL in 2019, for the deadly raids on North Kivu villages.

articles.headline: Indian-American politicians challenge New Delhi over civil rights and democratic freedoms
articles.title: Delhi faces new challenge from Samosa caucus
articles.summary: South Block is monitoring the rise of Indian-American politicians, largely from the Democratic Party, who are critical of the Indian government on civil rights and democratic freedoms. U.S. Congressman Ro Khanna criticized the Modi government on social media by applauding student protests and condemning Hindu nationalism, surprising the Ministry of External Affairs.
articles.description: Surge in Indian-American wins in U.S. midterms may test MEA as young Desi Democrat leaders are more ready to take up civil rights causes in India too

articles.headline: Adani Enterprises plans major annual capital expenditure over the next two years
articles.title: Adani Enterprises plans ₹35,000-40,000 crore annual capex in next two years
articles.summary: Adani Enterprises Ltd. announced plans to invest between ₹35,000 crore and ₹40,000 crore annually over the next two years, driven primarily by airports, data centres, and a polyvinyl chloride manufacturing complex in Gujarat. The conglomerate reported its highest-ever half-year earnings, supported by strong performance in its aviation and energy infrastructure divisions.
articles.description: The planned spending comes as the group seeks to scale up businesses built over recent years, including airports and data centres, while bringing its large manufacturing investments closer to commercial operation.

articles.headline: Manchester City suffers third consecutive league defeat against Nottingham Forest
articles.title: Man City suffers third straight Premier League loss at Forest and Arsenal opens 6-point lead
articles.summary: Manchester City fell to a third straight Premier League defeat after losing 3-1 away to Nottingham Forest, leaving the champions six points behind league leaders Arsenal. Liam Delap scored two goals for Forest, while Arsenal secured a narrow win against Hull and Leeds defeated Tottenham in a controversial match on Sunday.

articles.headline: Indian Oil Corporation plans to acquire crude and LPG carriers amid shipping risks
articles.title: IOC to buy crude, LPG ships as West Asia crisis exposes shipping risks
articles.summary: State-owned Indian Oil Corporation plans to purchase crude oil and liquefied petroleum gas carriers to strengthen its supply chain against shipping disruptions near the Strait of Hormuz. Surging freight costs and geopolitical tensions in West Asia prompted the refiner to increase its vessel ownership while posting a net profit of ₹21,630 crore in the September quarter.
articles.description: The company's board has already approved the purchase of a few vessels, and tenders were issued several months ago, Director of Finance Anuj Jain said during its second-quarter earnings call

articles.headline: Trump proposes UFC chief Dana White for White House press secretary role
articles.title: Trump offers UFC boss press secretary post, urges criminal probes of Democrats
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump announced on November 7, 2026, that he asked Ultimate Fighting Championship chief executive Dana White to become White House press secretary. Writing on Truth Social, Trump also requested six current or former titleholders to serve as assistants. Neither White nor TKO Group Holdings immediately responded to requests for comment regarding the proposal.
articles.description: Dana White had earlier shared a photo -- possibly AI-generated -- showing him behind the lectern in the White House press briefing room, captioned “On to the next chapter.”

articles.headline: Magnitude 5.7 earthquake strikes central Japan and injures dozens
articles.title: Strong earthquake shakes central Japan, shattering store windows, injuring at least 22
articles.summary: A strong tremor originating in Shizuoka Prefecture affected a wide area of central Japan, damaging store windows and halting normal transport speeds. According to local media, at least 22 people sustained injuries while evacuating buildings. The Japan Meteorological Agency recorded the magnitude at 5.7, while the U.S. Geological Survey measured it at 5.5, with Shizuoka and Aichi experiencing the most severe shaking.
articles.description: The quake, which struck at 1:04 a.m., was located about 40 kilometres below the earth’s surface in Shizuoka Prefecture. Aichi and Shizuoka are neighbouring regions

articles.headline: Bombay high court allows penal charges when transgender complainant identifies as woman.
articles.title: Bombay High Court allows BNS Section 75 charge where complainant identifies as woman
articles.summary: Justice Mehroz Pathan of the Bombay High Court ruled on November 3, 2026, that Section 75 of the Bharatiya Nyay Sanhita applies when a transgender complainant identifies as a woman and undergoes hormone therapy. The ruling involved an applicant named Vishal Ingle. The court also held that lacking an identity certificate under the Transgender Persons Act during the October 2025 assaults does not bar prosecution.
articles.description: The judge rejected the argument that Section 75 cannot apply because the complainant is a transgender and not a woman

articles.headline: Indian fast bowler Mohammed Shami retires from Test cricket
articles.title: Mohammed Shami: The end of an era in Indian Test cricket
articles.summary: Indian fast bowler Mohammed Shami announced his retirement from Test cricket after securing two hundred twenty-nine wickets across sixty-four matches during his career. The thirty-six-year-old athlete, who debuted against the West Indies at Eden Gardens in two thousand thirteen, missed selection for the New Zealand tour due to injury concerns. Shami will continue competing in white-ball formats for the national team.
articles.description: In the pantheon of great Indian seamers, headlined by Kapil Dev, Jasprit Bumrah, Javagal Srinath and Zaheer Khan, Shami too is in that group for the sheer impact he had on games that he played

articles.headline: Haitians cheer El Salvador’s Bukele amid gang war
articles.title: Haitians cheer El Salvador’s Bukele amid gang war
articles.description: Some Haitians have cheered on El Salvadorian troops deployed to fight gangs in the Haitian capital.

articles.headline: Magnitude 5.7 earthquake strikes central Japan and injures over 20 people
articles.title: Earthquake hits central Japan, injuring more than 20 people
articles.summary: A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck western Shizuoka Prefecture at a depth of 40 kilometers, injuring more than 20 people across Aichi and Shizuoka prefectures. The Japan Meteorological Agency reported no tsunami warnings but cautioned residents about potential strong aftershocks, mudslides, and falling rocks over the coming week while local train services experienced disruptions.
articles.description: The magnitude 5.7 quake hit Shizuoka prefecture, and authorities warn of possible strong aftershocks in coming days.

articles.headline: Donald Trump offers White House press secretary role to UFC chief Dana White
articles.title: Trump asks UFC chief Dana White to be White House press secretary
articles.summary: Ultimate Fighting Championship executive Dana White announced plans to discuss a potential appointment as White House press secretary during a meeting at the executive mansion. The proposal followed a public invitation on social media from the United States president, who also suggested several martial arts figures join the administration to assist with communications operations.
articles.description: Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO says he will meet with the US president on Monday to discuss the offer.

articles.headline: El Hierro declares emergency following sharp surge in migrant arrivals
articles.title: Canary Islands’ El Hierro declares emergency amid migrant, refugee influx
articles.summary: Authorities on the Spanish island of El Hierro declared an emergency and requested assistance from Madrid after more than 3,300 migrants and refugees arrived in approximately 30 boats since the start of November. Alpidio Armas, head of the governing council, cited severe strain on local facilities as maritime rescue services intercepted thousands of people on the deadly Atlantic route from West Africa.
articles.description: El Hierro asks Spanish government for help after more than 3,300 people arrived on boats since start of November.

articles.headline: Real Madrid defeat Valencia three to nil to match Barcelona points
articles.title: Real Madrid beat Valencia 3-0 to draw level with La Liga leaders Barcelona
articles.summary: Real Madrid secured a three to zero victory against ten-man Valencia at Mestalla Stadium to draw level with La Liga leaders Barcelona. Goals from Federico Valverde, Arda Guler and Kylian Mbappe drove the visitors to their eighth consecutive win across all competitions. Valencia suffered further frustration when Jose Gaya received a red card late in the match for a foul on Mbappe.
articles.description: Valverde and Guler's first-half goals put Madrid in the driving seat, and Mbappe added a third in the second half.

articles.headline: Mélenchon promises action against Israeli annexation if elected President
articles.title: Mélenchon promises action against Israeli annexation if elected President
articles.description: Mélenchon promises action against Israeli annexation if elected President

articles.headline: TDP and allies lead local body elections
articles.title: NDA extends winning streak, set to crush YSRCP in ZPTC and MPTC elections as well
articles.summary: Telugu Desam Party and its allies Jana Sena Party and Bharatiya Janata Party dominated the Zilla and Mandal Parishad Territorial Constituencies elections across 28 districts on November 5, 2026. According to State Election Commissioner Anil Chandra Punetha, counting proceeded peacefully. Meanwhile, Yuvajana Sramika Rythu Congress Party leaders alleged vote counting irregularities and untimely responses from election authorities.
articles.description: As of 9 p.m., the TDP wins 229 ZPTCs and 4,823 MPTCs, JSP 36 and 644, BJP eight and 130, and YSRCP 20 and 1,050; TDP upsets YSRCP by wresting Pulivendula ZPTC; fruit of good governance, says Lokesh

articles.headline: European security fears rise amid hybrid attacks
articles.title: Who is behind Europe’s suspected hybrid attacks?
articles.summary: Civilian infrastructure across Europe faces an ongoing wave of security threats involving false bomb hoaxes that disrupted aviation and cyberattacks targeting supermarket freezers. Italy stated that continental infrastructure is currently under attack. Security experts discussed potential coordination behind these incidents, while nations grapple with how to counter the aggression effectively and protect public services from further disruption.
articles.description: Bomb hoaxes and supermarket cyberattacks are heightening security fears.

articles.headline: Writer Jeyamohan depicts historical temple elephant transfer in Tamil Nadu
articles.title: Jumbo hustle: the transfer of elephants to Tamil Nadu’s temples
articles.summary: The book Mathagam by writer Jeyamohan features Kesavan, an elephant at the Adi Kesava Perumal Temple in Thiruvattar, to illustrate the shifting status of temple animals in Tamil Nadu. The story contrasts Kesavan's former royal favour and feared authority with his subsequent subjugation as a common working animal following the king death.
articles.description: The unseemly haste with which five elephants from Assam were transported to temples in Tamil Nadu raises pertinent questions about the process of animal transfer, and whether the rules are cheat proof. Here, Geetha Srimathi examines the entire issue threadbare, explaining how elephants are acquired for temples in the State, and the yawning gaps in the rules, and processes that allow humans to ‘trade’ in pachyderms.

articles.headline: Former Indian women's hockey coach Gurdial Singh Bhangu passes away
articles.title: India hockey coach Gurdial Singh Bhangu dies at 86
articles.summary: Gurdial Singh Bhangu, who coached India to a historic gold medal at the 2002 Commonwealth Games, has died in Surrey, Canada, at the age of 86. Hockey India confirmed the death of the Dronacharya Award winner, whose tactical instructions during the dramatic final against England secured the tournament victory. Bhangu previously coached the Nigerian women's team.
articles.description: Bhangu’s name will forever be associated with one of the most memorable victories in Indian women’s hockey: India’s 3-2 victory over England in the final at Manchester, becoming Commonwealth Games champions

articles.headline: Paraguay’s ousted president appears before prosecutors after impeachment
articles.title: Paraguay’s ousted president appears before prosecutors after impeachment
articles.description: Former Paraguayan President Santiago Pena has appeared before prosecutors.

articles.headline: Towhid Hridoy hits record-breaking double century for Bangladesh against West Indies
articles.title: Towhid Hridoy hits record-breaking double century for Bangladesh in second Test against West Indies
articles.summary: Bangladesh batsman Towhid Hridoy scored an unbeaten 242 runs off 359 deliveries during the second and final Test against West Indies on November 7, 2026. Hridoy surpassed Mushfiqur Rahim to become his country's highest individual Test scorer, helping Bangladesh reach 386 and secure a 30-run first-innings lead before bad light forced early stumps with West Indies at 7 for no loss.
articles.description: Hridoy became the fourth Bangladeshi batter to hit a double century after Mushfiqur Rahim, Shakib Al Hasan and Tamim Iqbal and also passed Mushfiqur’s 219 to become the highest individual scorer for the country

articles.headline: Masked protesters set off firecrackers and block roads in Albania
articles.title: Masked protesters set off firecrackers and block roads in Albania
articles.description: Police used water cannons to disperse masked protesters in Albania’s capital, Tirana.

articles.headline: Hardik Pandya misses Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy due to ongoing injury recovery
articles.title: Hardik Pandya misses Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy as injury setback delays return ahead of T20 WC
articles.summary: All-rounder Hardik Pandya was omitted from Baroda's 15-member squad for the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy as he continues recovering from a shin injury and previous fitness setbacks. His brother Krunal Pandya will captain the team, which plays its opening match against Chandigarh in Mumbai on November 14. Hardik has not played competitively since May 24.
articles.description: Hardik Pandya was initially included in India A’s one-day squad for the October series against Australia A but had to withdraw after suffering a fresh shin injury

articles.headline: Pro-Israel lobbying group AIPAC faces mixed outcomes in US midterm elections
articles.title: How did AIPAC-backed candidates fare in the US midterm elections?
articles.summary: The American Israel Public Affairs Committee and linked political action committees backed numerous winning candidates during the November 3, 2026, US midterm elections, though nearly two-thirds of their total spending went to losing campaigns. While the lobbying group achieved success in several primaries, prominent candidates opposing its funding or positions secured key victories across multiple states.
articles.description: Many candidates the pro-Israel group backed still won, but most of the money it spent went to candidates who lost.

articles.headline: Malaysian king warns defying house arrest order for former PM Najib
articles.title: Malaysian king warns against defying house arrest order for ex-PM Najib
articles.summary: Malaysia King Sultan Ibrahim warned that challenging his conditional pardon for jailed former Prime Minister Najib Razak amounts to defying his decree. The 73-year-old Najib was convicted in a 1Malaysia Development Berhad corruption case. Although his fine was paid, the attorney general blocked the transfer for clarification, prompting the monarch to declare the pardon clear and unambiguous.
articles.description: Attorney general postponed Najib Razak’s transfer from jail after court cleared him for house arrest on Friday.

articles.headline: BCCI pays tribute to retiring pace bowler Mohammad Shami
articles.title: Shami defined an era of pace bowling: BCCI
articles.summary: The Board of Control for Cricket in India paid tribute to Mohammad Shami after the pace bowler announced his retirement from Test cricket. Shami finished his career with 229 wickets from 64 matches, making him India's sixth most successful Test pacer. Former teammates and cricket figures praised his red ball career, seam presentation, and late movement.
articles.description: “Thank you for defining an era of Indian pace bowling, Test Cap #279,” wrote the BCCI said

articles.headline: Latvian farmers protest over ‘blood grain’ trade with Russia
articles.title: Latvian farmers protest over ‘blood grain’ trade with Russia
articles.description: Latvian farmers are protesting Russian grain transit, arguing that it helps fund Moscow’s war in Ukraine.

articles.headline: Demonstration in Berlin calls for an end to arming Israel
articles.title: Demonstration in Berlin calls for an end to arming Israel
articles.description: Demonstration in Berlin calls for an end to arming Israel

articles.headline: Houston mayor orders police to limit cooperation with ICE
articles.title: Houston mayor orders police to limit cooperation with ICE
articles.description: Houston Mayor John Whitmire has instructed police to limit contact with ICE, reversing the city’s previous approach.

articles.headline: Paraguay's ousted president charged over banking scandal
articles.title: Paraguay’s ousted president charged over banking scandal
articles.summary: Paraguay's former President Santiago Pena faced criminal charges including breach of trust and administration for personal gain following his impeachment and subsequent house arrest. The charges stem from his alleged involvement in the collapse of digital bank Ueno, which left millions of customers unable to access their savings and triggered widespread protests across the country.
articles.description: Santiago Pena was impeached over the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left millions unable to access their accounts.

articles.headline: Mathematics forms foundational basis for artificial intelligence advancement
articles.title: Mathematics key to AI’s advancement, says expert
articles.summary: Advanced artificial intelligence capabilities and logical reasoning rely fundamentally on mathematical equations, frameworks, and data algorithms according to Reheena Nasrin from Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology. Speaking at an international conference organised by Siddhartha Academy of Higher Education, experts emphasised that mathematical foundations remain critical for future digital intelligence development alongside presentations of more than two hundred research papers.

articles.headline: Pope Leo holds first mass in Uruguay and urges crowd to be bridge builders
articles.title: Pope Leo hold first mass in Uruguay, urges crowd to be ‘bridge builders’
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV addressed more than 30,000 attendees at Paris London Park in Paysandu during his first mass in western Uruguay on Saturday. The Roman Catholic Church head urged the crowd to share their faith and act as bridge builders. The pontiff is on a 12-day tour of Latin America that includes Argentina and Peru.
articles.description: Vatican says some 40,000 Catholic faithful attended the pontiff's service in Uruguay's western city of Paysandu.

articles.headline: Lucknow-bound IndiGo flight returns to Bengaluru following handwritten hijack threat note
articles.title: Lucknow-bound IndiGo flight returns to Bengaluru after hijack threat note found onboard
articles.summary: An IndiGo flight travelling from Bengaluru to Lucknow made an emergency return to Kempegowda International Airport after cabin crew discovered a handwritten hijack threat note in the lavatory. The aircraft landed safely after fifty-one minutes in the air and underwent thorough inspections by bomb disposal squads and police. Authorities subsequently declared the threat a hoax and launched an investigation to identify who left the note onboard.
articles.description: Flight 6E-451 had departed from Terminal 1 of KIA when cabin crew members found the note that said “This flight is going to hijack at 6.30, ignore and see the consequences”

articles.headline: M Priya stitches costumes for Theyyam performers in male-dominated tradition
articles.title: A woman stitches her way into the male-dominated ritual tradition of Theyyam
articles.summary: M Priya of Kannayi Mukkottu has spent over 15 years specializing in traditional attire for Theyyam performers in Kannur and Kasaragod districts. Learning the craft from her father, she produces specialized garments like kaani and kachunkaraa during the season from November to May. Performers praise her precise stitching, which supports a cultural tradition where women are largely absent.
articles.description: Based in Kannayi Mukkottu near Payyannur, she spends the Theyyam season creating attire and accessories, a craft she learned from her father and now sustains as a specialised, highly regarded artisan.

articles.headline: Karnataka High Court rules Enforcement Directorate is not a super cop
articles.title: Enforcement Directorate is not a ‘super cop’, says Karnataka High Court
articles.summary: The High Court of Karnataka ruled that the Directorate of Enforcement cannot file private complaints to initiate money laundering probes when competent agencies decline scheduled offences. Justice M.I. Arun allowed petitions challenging proceedings initiated by the agency. The court emphasized that enforcement powers are derivative under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act and must strictly follow established legal checks and balances.
articles.description: ED cannot file private complaint when other agencies decline to act on its information on alleged offences, court said while quashing ED cases against K.Y. Nanjegowda, Congress MLA from Malur

articles.headline: Manipur inaugurates the Northeast region's first artificial intelligence career intelligence hub
articles.title: Manipur gets Northeast’s first AI-enabled career intelligence hub
articles.summary: Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh inaugurated the artificial intelligence-enabled Career Intelligence Hub at Tamphasana Girls’ Higher Secondary School in Imphal on Saturday, November 7, 2026. Established under the Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme, the facility aims to provide students with technology-driven career guidance and personalized counselling amidst ongoing regional conflict.
articles.description: Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh says the facility marks a significant step towards integrating artificial intelligence into the education and career guidance ecosystem of the State

articles.headline: East Bengal reaches the AFC Women's Champions League knockout stage despite defeat
articles.title: East Bengal makes history in AFC Women's Champions League
articles.summary: East Bengal FC advanced to the AFC Women’s Champions League quarterfinals on Saturday despite a 2-0 defeat against North Korea’s April 25 SC. Goals from Han Jin-Hong and Oh Sol-Song secured the win for April 25 SC, but the Kolkata side advanced as a top third-placed team by avoiding a defeat by more than three goals.
articles.description: The Kolkata team becomes the first Indian club to advance to the knockout stage of the elite competition

articles.headline: Shreya N. Gowda secures first rank in national defence entrance exam
articles.title: Shreya N. Gowda from Bhadravati tops NDA & NA entrance exam
articles.summary: An engineering student from Bhadravati has achieved the top position among female candidates in the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy examination. The Union Public Service Commission announced the results on November 5, 2026. She will undergo military training in Maharashtra and Uttarakhand. State ministers and local parliamentarians congratulated her on this accomplishment.
articles.description: Shreya N. Gowda of Thimlapura in Bhadravati town has topped the list of women candidates who qualified in the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission

articles.headline: Jerusalem Daily: Heavy rains flood Gaza
articles.title: Jerusalem Daily: Heavy rains flood Gaza
articles.description: Jerusalem Daily: Heavy rains flood Gaza

articles.headline: Heavy rain floods tens of thousands of displaced persons tents in Gaza
articles.title: Heavy rain inundates shelters for people displaced by war in Gaza
articles.summary: Severe downpours on November 7, 2026, inundated roughly seventy thousand tents housing displaced citizens across Gaza, according to local authorities. The flooding caused structural collapses and injuries while overwhelming civil defence teams operating without equipment. Residents and officials appealed for international intervention, emergency shelter, and unrestricted humanitarian aid to prevent further catastrophe amid ongoing military operations.
articles.description: In a statement, the Hamas-run government media office said that about "70,000 tents sheltering tens of thousands of displaced people were flooded on the first day" of rains

articles.headline: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke criticizes central government during Kochi protest
articles.title: CJP founder launches scathing attack on Central government
articles.summary: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar during a demonstration in Kochi on November 7, 2026. Criticizing the Narendra Modi-led administration over alleged electoral irregularities, Mr. Dipke asserted that the government must fall in the 2029 general elections. The event featured addresses by various activists and political figures including actor Prakash Raj.
articles.description: Addressing a protest named ‘Jantar Mantar @ Kochi’ demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR), Abhijeet Dipke stresses that “Modi will go out in 2029.”

articles.headline: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani reports personal data leak by hackers
articles.title: Italian foreign minister says hackers leaked his personal data
articles.summary: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani announced on social media that cybercriminals published his personal data on the dark web due to his nation's support for Ukraine. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni attributed the incident to pro-Russian hackers, expressing concern over the circulation of confidential institutional information. Mr. Tajani confirmed that the threats also extend to his family members as the government maintains its military and humanitarian backing for Kyiv.
articles.description: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has blamed pro-Russian hackers for publishing the details online.

articles.headline: Biswajit Basu becomes fourth retired judge to resign from tribunal
articles.title: Biswajit Basu becomes fourth retired judge to resign from West Bengal SIR tribunal
articles.summary: Retired Calcutta High Court judge Biswajit Basu resigned from a Special Intensive Revision tribunal in West Bengal citing personal reasons, making him the fourth former judge to step down. The tribunals were constituted by the Election Commission of India to hear thirty-eight lakh voter appeals following the deletion of ninety-one lakh electors during the revision process held between October 2025 and February 2026.
articles.description: Others who quit are former Calcutta HC Chief Justice T.S. Sivagnanam, former judges Ranjit Kumar Bagh and Indrajit Chatterjee; judges heading the 19 tribunals have complained about the slow pace of disposal of 38 lakh pending appeals

articles.headline: Abdul El-Sayed wins US Senate seat in historic midterm election
articles.title: Abdul El-Sayed: The progressive’s progress
articles.summary: Abdul El-Sayed, a physician and epidemiologist, defeated Republican former Representative Mike Rogers with 52.5% of the vote to become the first Muslim member of the United States Senate. Published on November 4, 2026, the report notes this victory occurred during the midterm elections alongside Democratic wins in various regions, though analysts emphasized the unique significance of Dr. El-Sayed breaking long-standing political barriers.
articles.description: Abdul El-Sayed’s describes himself as ‘just a capitalist who understands how capitalism works’ and identifies as a progressive; his candidacy was backed by leading figures such as Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh chief minister orders relief and price controls after cyclone
articles.title: Cyclone Murasu: Andhra Pradesh CM orders swift power restoration, price control measures
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu directed officials to expedite relief operations following Cyclone Murasu, focusing on power restoration and price regulation of essential commodities. Authorities reported that repair work is underway across 1,825 villages, essential items have been distributed to 3.82 lakh families, and legal action has been taken against 204 traders for violating pricing directives.
articles.description: Naidu tells officials to monitor field-level relief operations, complete damage assessments at the earliest and esnure prompt financial assistance to the affected families

articles.headline: K.C. Venugopal claims Chief Election Commissioner will be forced to step down
articles.title: Gyanesh Kumar will soon be forced to step down, says K.C. Venugopal
articles.summary: All India Congress Committee general secretary K.C. Venugopal accused the leadership of electoral malpractice and stated that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar would soon be forced to resign. Speaking at a rally in Kozhikode, Venugopal alleged large-scale vote theft across multiple states and claimed that 13.32 crore voters had been deleted from electoral rolls nationwide.
articles.description: AICC general secretary accuses Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah of using the Election Commission of India to undermine the Congress and influence electoral outcomes

articles.headline: Guatemalan congressman Julio Portillo and three police officers killed in attack
articles.title: Guatemalan lawmaker and three police officers killed in armed attack
articles.summary: Congressman Julio Portillo and three National Civil Police officers were killed in an armed assault in Rio Hondo within the Zacapa department, according to Guatemalan authorities. President Bernardo Arevalo instructed security forces to cooperate with prosecutors investigating the incident. The National Unity of Hope party confirmed the death of Portillo, who had previously won his seat for the Cabal party in 2023.
articles.description: It happened in a region of the country known to have drug trafficking activity.

articles.headline: Bengaluru police retrieve two bodies in Rajajinagar murder case
articles.title: Rajajinagar murders: Police retrieve two more bodies from Tamil Nadu; search on for four
articles.summary: Bengaluru police investigating the Rajajinagar murder case retrieved two decomposed bodies from near the Yercaud forest area in Salem district, Tamil Nadu. Authorities believe the remains belong to the prime accused Indushekhar's wife Sunita and mother-in-law Roopavathi. Indushekhar was previously arrested for allegedly killing seven family members over eighteen days. Deputy Commissioner of Police B. Nemagoud is leading the ongoing investigation.
articles.description: Teams have been deployed to conduct search operations at Chamundi Hills and Shiradi Ghat as part of the next phase of the investigation to find the missing bodies

articles.headline: Historic Lavi Fair opens in Rampur with traditional trade and culture
articles.title: Rampur’s Lavi Fair: Storytelling through 300 years of Himalayan trade and tradition
articles.summary: The annual Lavi Fair in Rampur Bushahr, Himachal Pradesh, runs through November with trading grounds offering textiles, dry fruits, and Chamurthi horses. Originating from a 17th-century treaty, the event generates substantial revenue primarily allocated to local cultural programs. Deputy Commissioner of Police Anupam Kashyap and officials emphasize the fair's enduring role in celebrating Himalayan heritage and supporting small-scale women entrepreneurs.
articles.description: Rampur Bushahr’s Lavi Fair in Himachal Pradesh traces a Himalayan journey from wool and barter to women entrepreneurs and digital payments

articles.headline: Health minister announces free Risdiplam distribution for SMA patients in all districts
articles.title: Free Risdiplam for SMA patients to be made available in all districts
articles.summary: The government will make the spinal muscular atrophy medication Risdiplam available through medical colleges in all districts to ease patient distress. Health Minister K. Muraleedharan announced that the Additional Chief Secretary will coordinate the decentralised distribution. Officials are also working to remove the current age restriction of twelve years to benefit all eligible patients across the region.

articles.headline: US government approves Nvidia chip sales to empty office in China
articles.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
articles.summary: Concerns have emerged regarding the vetting process after the United States Commerce Department approved Nvidia chip sales to a Chinese firm named New Matrix, which operates out of an empty office. According to The New York Times, the company's owners have ties to a blacklisted private equity firm. The Trump administration previously relaxed chip sales limits following an agreement involving revenue sharing and lobbying efforts.
articles.description: Concerns are being raised that neither the Commerce Department nor Nvidia are doing their due diligence when it comes to vetting Chinese firms cleared to handle the company's H200 AI chips. According to The New York Times, New Matrix is on the list of approved firms, yet its offices are empty, "a hollow gray shell […]

articles.headline: Iran constructs underground military complexes for weapons production and storage
articles.title: Iran’s IRGC says building underground sites for weapons production, storage
articles.summary: The Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps announced the construction of underground military complexes designed to maintain weapons manufacturing and storage during heavy bombardments. Speaking in Tehran, spokesperson Hossein Mohebbi highlighted advancements in stealth technology and missile capabilities. Meanwhile, the United States military launched limited strikes on Qeshm Island as diplomatic and economic tensions between the nations persist.
articles.description: IRGC says underground military complexes allow missile production to continue even under heavy bombardment.

articles.headline: Trump’s new chief of staff Stephen Miller says he ‘saved America’
articles.title: Trump’s new chief of staff Stephen Miller says he ‘saved America’
articles.description: Stephen Miller, US President Donald Trump’s incoming chief of staff praises him.

articles.headline: Michel Barnier warns United Kingdom cannot cherry pick single market access
articles.title: UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC
