articles.summary: The European Union's former Brexit negotiator Michel Barnier stated that the United Kingdom cannot selectively access the single market without accepting all four freedoms, including the free movement of people. Speaking to the BBC, Barnier asserted that any UK return to the internal market would require adherence to standard bloc conditions and rejected the possibility of reinstating a British financial rebate.
articles.description: The former Brexit negotiator says EU countries would reject any British attempts to follow economic rules "a la carte".

articles.headline: Telangana Women's Commission questions inaction over illegal oocyte racket
articles.title: Agents booked, five fertility centres named in Hyderabad’s illegal oocyte racket; Telangana Women’s Commission questions inaction
articles.summary: The Telangana Women's Commission has questioned authorities regarding the lack of legal action against five fertility centres allegedly involved in an illegal egg collection racket in Hyderabad. Forty-three vulnerable women were rescued after being offered between twenty thousand and thirty thousand rupees per cycle, while operators made about three lakh rupees per cycle. Commission Chairperson Nerella Sharada identified the implicated institutions as Indira IVF Centre, Narmada Fertility Centre, Oasis Fertility Centre, Sadguru ART Centre, and Padmaja Fertility Centre, and demanded immediate inquiries and strict legal measures.

articles.headline: Karnataka Cabinet approves Bill to establish Sannati development authority
articles.title: Sannati set for a heritage makeover as Karnataka Cabinet clears development authority Bill
articles.summary: The Karnataka Cabinet approved the Sannati Development Authority Bill, 2026, to transform the ancient Buddhist site in Kalaburagi district into an international cultural and tourism destination. Announced by Home Minister Priyank Kharge, the statutory framework aims to conserve Sannati and the neighbouring Kanaganahalli archaeological site, where excavations previously uncovered the Great Stupa of the Netherworlds and inscriptions bearing the name of Emperor Ashoka. The proposed authority will oversee development plans, land acquisition, and regulated construction to address years of site neglect.
articles.description: Proposed legislation aims to transform the ancient Buddhist site into an international heritage and tourism destination, with emphasis on conservation of Ashokan edicts and archaeological treasures

articles.headline: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani targets pro-Russian hackers over data leak
articles.title: Italian Foreign Minister says pro-Russian hackers targeted him over Ukraine support
articles.summary: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani stated on November 7, 2026, that pro-Russian hackers published his personal data on the dark web due to Italy supporting Ukraine. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni expressed concern over the incident. Tajani noted hackers sought information about his family, while cybersecurity authorities are investigating the breach linked to ministry efforts.
articles.description: Moscow has not commented on the incident. Russia has consistently ​denied any involvement ‌in cyberattacks or hacking operations abroad

articles.headline: Documentary highlights cultural restoration in Mosul after ISIL liberation
articles.title: The Lions by the River Tigris: Restoring Mosul’s artefacts
articles.summary: The documentary film The Lions by the River Tigris by Zaradasht Ahmed examines cultural revival in Mosul, Iraq. It follows a fisherman guarding a historic gate and a collector trying to save local heritage after the city was liberated from ISIL nearly 10 years ago, highlighting the human cost of war and resilience.
articles.description: When the ancient Iraqi city of Mosul is devastated after liberation from ISIL, three men strive to revive its beauty.

articles.headline: Iraq foreign minister addresses territorial security and oil exports
articles.title: Iraq’s FM says external parties using Iraqi soil to attack neighbours
articles.summary: Iraqi Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein stated on November 7, 2026, that Baghdad is investigating attacks launched from its territory against neighbouring states. Speaking to Al Jazeera, Hussein discussed negotiations with Iran-aligned factions, regional security committees combating ISIL, and the resumption of $60bn in oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz.
articles.description: Iraqi foreign minister tells Al Jazeera that Baghdad is investigating attacks on the Gulf launched from its territory.

articles.headline: ABB India reports automation growth boosts workforce and hiring
articles.title: Automation has boosted employment, hiring of low-skilled workers in India, says ABB chief
articles.summary: Engineering firm ABB India has increased its workforce by 57% since 2021, reaching over 11,000 employees. CEO Sanjeev Sharma stated that automation allows the company to train lower-skilled workers for complex tasks using guided technology. The firm plans to invest $75 million through 2027, focusing on expanding operations into India's Tier-II and Tier-III cities.
articles.description: ABB India has committed to invest $75 million in India over 2026 and 2027 to fuel its organic expansion in the country, with a new focus on Tier-II and Tier-III cities

articles.headline: New Zealand’s prime minister says election is ‘too close to call’
articles.title: New Zealand’s prime minister says election is ‘too close to call’
articles.description: New Zealand prime minister Christopher Luxon says he has a pathway to form the next government.

articles.headline: Hakeem Jeffries faces party division as he pursues House speaker role
articles.title: Who is Hakeem Jeffries, the Democrat poised to become House speaker?
articles.summary: Following midterm elections, US House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries of New York is poised to become the first Black speaker of the House of Representatives. However, his cautious political approach, stance on Israel, and past meetings with Jared Kushner have sparked online petitions and opposition from progressive lawmakers within the Democratic Party.
articles.description: Likely to become the first Black House speaker, Jeffries faces pressure from progressives over Trump and Israel.

articles.headline: French left-wing leader Jean-Luc Melenchon campaigns ahead of presidential election
articles.title: ‘Radical’ or ‘hero’?: France debates leftist candidate Jean-Luc Melenchon
articles.summary: Hard-left French politician Jean-Luc Melenchon of the France Unbowed party is presenting his presidential programme at a rally in Le Bourget on November 7, 2026. His platform includes lowering the retirement age to 60, raising the minimum wage, and pulling France out of NATO, drawing both strong support from protesters and criticism from opponents.
articles.description: The hard-left leader has transformed into a real contender in next year presidential elections.

articles.headline: Vaishnavi Adkar and Rutuja Bhosale make history at Chennai Open
articles.title: Adkar-Bhosale become first all-Indian pair to reach WTA Tour doubles final
articles.summary: India's Vaishnavi Adkar and Rutuja Bhosale advanced to the Women's Tennis Association Tour-level doubles final on November 7, 2026, defeating Weronika Falkowska and Alana Smith 6-2, 2-6, 10-8 at the Chennai Open. This victory marks the first time an all-Indian women's pair has reached this stage at the main tour level, setting a new milestone for national tennis history.
articles.description: The achievement is significant for Indian women's tennis, with no all-Indian combination having previously reached a final at the main WTA Tour level

articles.headline: Varanasi officials deny municipal involvement in demolishing Bismillah Khan's house portion
articles.title: Akhilesh Yadav targets BJP after part of Bismillah Khan's house demolished; Varanasi officials deny role
articles.summary: A political controversy emerged after Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav accused the ruling government of destroying part of late shehnai maestro Bismillah Khan's residence. However, Varanasi Municipal Corporation officials stated that the family members demolished the dilapidated structure independently after declining a museum proposal, following the resolution of an internal property dispute.
articles.description: Akhilesh Yadav slammed the "BJP and its narrow-minded allies" over the demolition in a social media post, calling them "orthodox conservatives with a narrow mindset”

articles.headline: Death toll reaches three following explosion and fire at Assam oil facility
articles.title: Assam OIL facility fire death toll rises to three
articles.summary: Two injured workers succumbed to their injuries at hospitals in Dibrugarh and Guwahati following a fire that erupted after an explosion at an Oil India Limited facility in eastern Assam's Dibrugarh. The incident began at an indirect bath heater undergoing maintenance. The fatalities bring the total death toll to three, while four other workers continue receiving medical treatment.
articles.description: Two workers succumbed to their injuries at a private hospital in Guwahati on November 7

articles.headline: Pro-Russian hackers leak Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani's data on dark web
articles.title: Pro-Russian hackers leak Italian foreign minister’s data on dark web
articles.summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni stated that pro-Russian hackers leaked personal data belonging to Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani on the dark web. Tajani confirmed the breach on social media, noting that cybercriminals are seeking further information and exposing him to threats. Officials linked the cyberattack to Italy's steadfast political stance supporting Ukraine's sovereignty and democratic freedom.
articles.description: The prime minister blames pro-Russian hackers for the leak, as her top diplomat says the cyberthreat was ongoing.

articles.headline: Barcelona and Atletico Madrid meet in top-of-the-table La Liga clash
articles.title: Atletico Madrid vs Barcelona: La Liga – predictions, team news, lineups
articles.summary: League leaders Barcelona travel to face second-placed Atletico Madrid in a crucial La Liga fixture separated by only two points. Barcelona manager Hansi Flick will navigate several injuries, including midfielder Rodri, while relying on the prolific form of winger Raphinha. Meanwhile, Diego Simeone's Atletico side enters the match bolstered by a seven-game winning streak in the Spanish top flight.
articles.description: Barcelona and Atletico clash on Sunday in a blockbuster encounter which could upend the La Liga title race this season.

articles.headline: Midterm results shape political strategies for both parties ahead of 2028
articles.title: Four things we learned this week about 2028 White House race
articles.summary: Democratic gains in congressional and state elections have reshaped the 2028 presidential landscape, empowering potential candidates such as Georgia Senator Jon Ossoff and Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro. Meanwhile, Republican figures like Vice-President JD Vance faced internal party criticism over election losses linked to the administration economic and foreign policies. Both political parties are evaluating shifting voter coalitions, particularly concerning Hispanic communities and economic populist messaging.
articles.description: The seismic Democratic gains in Congress could shape the presidential election, so who had a good night and who's making moves?

articles.headline: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh announces post-tenure enrollment for all Agniveers
articles.title: All Agniveers eligible for regular enrollment post 2-year tenure extension: Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that all Agniveers completing an additional two-year tenure will be eligible for regular soldier enrollment based on willingness and selection criteria. Speaking at the Bagdogra Air Force station, Singh called the decision a significant Diwali gift. The policy follows an earlier government announcement altering the Agnipath scheme, which initially retained only twenty five percent of recruits after four years.
articles.description: Upon completion of the two-year engagement period, all Agniveers will get an opportunity to be enrolled as regular soldiers, subject to their willingness and their meeting selection criteria, Rajnath Singh said

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay opposes Mekedatu dam inspection
articles.title: T.N. CM Vijay writes to PM Modi expressing concerns over inspection of Union govt. officials regarding Mekedatu dam project
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay wrote to Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressing deep concern over site inspections by Union government officials for the proposed Mekedatu dam project. Vijay urged the Prime Minister to withhold approvals without co-basin state consent. He emphasized that the reservoir proposed by Karnataka would severely impact Cauvery basin water deliveries and farmer livelihoods in Tamil Nadu.
articles.description: CM Vijay said there was an apprehension growing among farmers of Tamil Nadu over the recent developments with respect to the proposed Mekedatu Dam Project of Karnataka

articles.headline: Assam police apprehend and expel twenty-eight illegal Bangladeshi immigrants
articles.title: A total of 28 illegal immigrants apprehended, expelled: Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma
articles.summary: Assam Police in Sribhumi district apprehended and expelled twenty-eight Bangladeshi nationals who were allegedly staying illegally in the state, according to Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma. Taking to social media, Sarma stated that the state government remains fully committed to maintaining border security and stopping infiltration. Authorities have maintained high alert along the international border following regional disturbances.
articles.description: In a post on X, Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma said the State government would continue its drive against infiltration and would not compromise on Assam's security and identity

articles.headline: Bengaluru cab driver Indushekar arrested for murdering wife and six relatives
articles.title: Bengaluru cab driver kills wife, six members of her family
articles.summary: Bengaluru police arrested fifty-two-year-old cab driver Indushekar for allegedly murdering his wife and six relatives, including a seven-year-old boy, over an eighteen-day period. Investigators revealed the accused used a grinding stone after inviting victims to dinner. Police rescued an eleven-year-old boy and recovered one body while searching multiple disposal sites across Karnataka based on the accused statements regarding family disputes.
articles.description: The murders are believed to have been carried out between October 16 and November 3, with the bodies dumped at multiple locations on Bengaluru’s outskirts, including one near the foothills of Nandi Hills in Chickballapur.

articles.headline: Nepal faces massive recovery challenges following a deadly flash flood disaster
articles.title: Nepal’s fight to rebuild after flood disaster
articles.summary: Rescue teams are struggling to locate thousands of missing individuals and support displaced families after an extreme torrent of rock and ice rushed down a Himalayan mountain on August 26, 2026. According to the Al Jazeera programme 101 East, the catastrophe caused at least 1,400 fatalities and left over 5,000 people unaccounted for, highlighting ongoing climate vulnerabilities across the affected Himalayan valleys.
articles.description: 101 East reveals Nepal's efforts to save lives and rebuild communities after a devastating natural disaster.

articles.headline: Sonia Gandhi reflects on personal memoir and life in India
articles.title: ‘Where I truly belong’: Sonia Gandhi on her memoir ‘Belonging: A Journey of Love’
articles.summary: Indian National Congress politician Sonia Gandhi reflected on her upcoming personal memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, detailing her transition from a small Italian town to the center of Indian public life. Gandhi described how love, grief, and a sense of duty guided her through decades in India following personal tragedies and the loss of family members to violence.
articles.description: Ahead of the release of her much-discussed memoir, the senior Congress party leader talks about her journey from privacy to public life in India

articles.headline: Rajiv Ranjan Singh proposes voter identity cards for welfare beneficiary identification
articles.title: Voter ID for welfare? What Rajiv Ranjan Singh’s proposal could mean | Explained
articles.summary: Union Minister for Panchayati Raj Rajiv Ranjan Singh stated on November 3, 2026, that voter cards combined with biometric authentication should determine welfare scheme beneficiaries and payments. The Janata Dal (United) leader argued that Aadhaar cards are easily forged and cause fraud. Historically, the colonial-era ration card initiated household and residential enumeration for welfare entitlements.
articles.description: Opposition parties have linked this announcement to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, in which 13.5 crore electors were reportedly removed. They argue that disenfranchisement will now be coupled with exclusion from welfare programmes.

articles.headline: Iran military declares itself stronger against United States conflict
articles.title: Iran says forces ‘stronger’ than at beginning of war
articles.summary: Iranian Army Spokesperson Mohammad Akraminia stated that the nation's armed forces have grown stronger and more experienced following direct confrontations with the United States and Israel. The remarks follow a recent U.S. military reward offer for intelligence on Tehran's nuclear programme. Meanwhile, mediators continue diplomatic efforts led by regional figures to address the ongoing West Asia conflict.
articles.description: The Islamic Republic’s armed forces, having gained experience from direct confrontation with United States and Israel, are stronger than they were at the beginning of the war, Iranian Army Spokesperson Mohammad Akraminia said

articles.headline: John Bolton says JD Vance is distancing himself from Donald Trump
articles.title: Vance distancing himself from Trump ahead of 2028 Presidential race: Ex-U.S. NSA Bolton
articles.summary: Former United States national security adviser John Bolton stated that Vice President JD Vance is attempting to distance himself from President Donald Trump by blaming the Iran war for Republican midterm losses. Bolton described Vance's strategy as politically risky and argued that voter discontent was primarily driven by persistently high prices, inflation, and unfulfilled economic promises. Bolton also warned that ongoing domestic political turmoil in Washington could sideline vital foreign policy priorities, including defense cooperation with India.
articles.description: Bolton described Vance's remarks as "very wrong" and a "big political mistake", saying the Republicans overlooked broader voter dissatisfaction with the economy, rising prices, and Trump's tariff policies

articles.headline: Explosion at Ghaziabad police outpost injures food delivery person
articles.title: One injured in explosion at Ghaziabad police outpost; ATS, bomb disposal team at site
articles.summary: A food delivery person sustained minor injuries in an explosion at the Vasundhara police outpost under the Indirapuram police station in Ghaziabad district on November 6, 2026. The blast damaged window panes, prompting investigations by the Bomb Disposal Squad, Field Unit, and Forensic Team of the Uttar Pradesh police. Ghaziabad Police Commissioner J. Ravinder Goud stated the exact cause remains under investigation from all possible angles.
articles.description: ‘At that time, a Sub-Inspector and a delivery boy were present at the location; following this, an investigation was initiated, and all available evidence at the scene has been collected,’ said Ghaziabad Police Commissioner J. Ravinder Goud

articles.headline: Paraguay Senate removes President Santiago Pena from office
articles.title: How a bank collapse in Paraguay brought down the country’s President | Explained
articles.summary: Paraguay's Senate voted to remove President Santiago Pena from office and placed him under house arrest following impeachment proceedings initiated against him for misconduct. Vice-President Pedro Alliana was subsequently sworn in as interim President on November 7. Both politicians belong to the Colorado Party, which has remained the dominant political force in Paraguay since the 1940s.
articles.description: Millions of customers, abruptly, lost access to their savings accounts and pension payments after regulators seized the bank, setting off a sequence of events that culminated in a change of political leadership

articles.headline: Maharashtra Anti-Terrorism Squad arrests Maoist in Thane district
articles.title: Maoist with ₹10 Lakh Bounty Arrested in Thane
articles.summary: The Maharashtra Anti-Terrorism Squad apprehended a 45-year-old Maoist carrying a bounty of 10 lakh rupees from Thakurli in Thane district. The suspect, identified as Sanjay Sarju Yadav alias Godaram Yadav, served as a zonal committee member of a banned organization and had been hiding in the area for ten days. Following the joint intelligence operation with Jharkhand Police, authorities transferred custody of the suspect to Jharkhand law enforcement officers for formal arrest.
articles.description: ​Acting on intelligence provided by Jharkhand Police to senior officials of the Maharashtra ATS, the local unit verified the inputs and conducted the operation

articles.headline: Pakistani astronaut selected for China space station mission
articles.title: Pakistani astronaut to join China’s next space station mission
articles.summary: China’s Manned Space Agency has chosen a Pakistani astronaut as a payload specialist for the Shenzhou-24 mission, making them the first foreign national to visit the country's space station. The mission is expected by the end of the year under bilateral cooperation tied to Beijing's Belt and Road Initiative, according to Chinese state media. Additionally, the China National Space Administration will deploy Pakistan’s Jinnah-1 lunar rover.
articles.description: The unnamed individual will be the first foreign national to visit China's space station as part of Shenzhou-24 mission.

articles.headline: Former Chief Election Commissioner alleges West Bengal polls are invalid
articles.title: West Bengal election is not legally valid: Former CEC S.Y. Quraishi
articles.summary: Former Chief Election Commissioner S.Y. Quraishi asserted that the West Bengal elections lacked legal validity and criticized the special intensive revision process. Speaking in Kolkata, he emphasized that decisions by the Election Commission of India require majority consensus, while ruling party officials dismissed his allegations as politically motivated.
articles.description: The former top poll official also said that the Election Commission of India is supposed to make decisions based on a majority

articles.headline: Thirteen Adivasi families face delays in Wayanad landslide rehabilitation
articles.title: Wayanad landslides: Despite township progress, 13 Adivasi families still caught between ‘no-go zones’ and delayed rehab
articles.summary: Thirteen Adivasi families displaced by the 2024 Mundakkai-Chooralmala landslide in Keralam remain without permanent housing despite township progress for other survivors. Authorities declared their original neighborhoods no-go zones, forcing some into rented homes while others returned to the forest because construction on alternative land allocated under the Forest Rights Act has not started yet.
articles.description: Some now live in rented accommodation with government assistance, cut off from their forest environment and traditional livelihoods. Others have returned to the forest, as construction of the promised houses on alternative land allocated to them at Puthiyavillage in Meppadi under Forest Rights Act, 2006 is yet to begin

articles.headline: Palestinian citizens of Israel face backlash following election gains
articles.title: Palestinian citizens of Israel put to ‘loyalty test’ after election wins
articles.summary: Arab parties secured a record nineteen seats in the Israeli parliament during the October twenty-seventh election, driven by high voter turnout in towns like Arrabeh. Thabet Abu Rass noted this positioned the bloc to influence coalition politics. However, politicians from Likud and figures such as Itamar Ben-Gvir accused the parties of election fraud, while media outlets propagated inflammatory rhetoric, exacerbating systemic marginalization experienced by Palestinian citizens.
articles.description: Palestinian citizens of Israel say Arab parties' success in recent elections has led to growing pressure.

articles.headline: Is your petrol really E20? Karnataka claims ethanol levels reached 31%
articles.title: Is your petrol really E20? Karnataka claims ethanol levels reached 31%
articles.description: A major controversy has emerged over ethanol blending in petrol after the Karnataka government claimed that fuel samples collected from multiple districts contained ethanol levels significantly above India’s permitted E20 limit.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu restructures crop loan waiver scheme and extends deadline
articles.title: Tamil Nadu government restructures crop loan waiver scheme, extends eligibility period by a month
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu government restructured its crop loan waiver scheme, granting a flat seventy-five thousand rupee waiver to farmers with loans exceeding that amount from cooperative institutions, while retaining full waivers for loans up to seventy-five thousand rupees. Administered by the Cooperation, Food and Consumer Protection Department, the revised initiative extends eligibility to loans obtained up to March 31, 2026, increasing total estimated expenditure to over nine billion rupees.
articles.description: The State government has sanctioned an additional ₹2,842.77 crore towards the implementation of the expanded scheme

articles.headline: India overhauls official statistical system with VISTAR initiative
articles.title: VISTAR: India’s shift towards a real-time, technology-driven statistical system | Explained
articles.summary: India is overhauling its official statistical architecture at both central and state levels through the VISTAR initiative. The project aims to transition data collection beyond periodic surveys by utilizing interoperable datasets to generate timely socioeconomic indicators for evidence-based policymaking.
articles.description: For an economy aspiring to become a developed nation by 2047, the statistical blind spots could translate into costly policy mistakes, misdirected investments and ineffective welfare schemes

articles.headline: Abhishek Banerjee reports attack on his West Bengal residence
articles.title: Abhishek alleges attack by ‘BJP hooligans’ on residence, claims 7th attempt on his life in 6 months
articles.summary: All India Trinamool Congress leader Abhishek Banerjee stated that his residence in Kalighat was attacked by Bharatiya Janata Party supporters during his birthday gatherings. The Diamond Harbour Member of Parliament claimed this incident marked the seventh attempt on his life in six months, adding that clashes erupted after slogans were shouted and banners were torn outside his home.
articles.description: The Trinamool MP alleged that his residence was attacked by ‘BJP hooligans’ on the occasion of his birth anniversary

articles.headline: Houston mayor directs police to limit cooperation with federal immigration officials
articles.title: Texas mayor instructs police to limit co-operation with ICE
articles.summary: Houston Mayor John Whitmire ordered police to restrict cooperation with Immigration and Customs Enforcement following recent midterm elections. Officers will now only contact federal agents if an arrested individual has an internal administrative warrant. The directive follows public outcry after an enforcement officer fatally shot a motorist. Department of Homeland Security officials criticized the decision, while Austin implemented similar policy changes.
articles.description: There has been months of public outcry in Houston after an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer fatally shot a man who was driving to work.

articles.headline: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed becomes first Muslim US Senator-elect in Michigan
articles.title: Who is Abdul El-Sayed, first Muslim U.S. Senator-elect?
articles.summary: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan's open Senate seat on Tuesday by defeating former Republican lawmaker Mike Rogers. The 42-year-old former public health official secured a crucial victory that prevented Republicans from claiming the seat vacated by retiring Senator Gary Peters. El-Sayed campaigned on lowering living costs and reducing corporate influence, while overcoming unsupported Republican allegations regarding ties to the Muslim Brotherhood.
articles.description: Abdul El-Sayed is set to become the first Muslim to enter the U.S. Senate with his victory over former Republican lawmaker Mike Rogers in midterm elections

articles.headline: Houston mayor limits police cooperation with ICE
articles.title: Houston mayor curbs cooperation of US city’s police with ICE
articles.summary: Houston Mayor John Whitmire signed an executive order on November 7, 2026, restricting city police from cooperating with United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement unless a jailable offense occurs. The policy change reverses an earlier directive issued under pressure from Texas Governor Greg Abbott. Police Chief J Noe Diaz supported the shift, which aims to reduce fear and anxiety among immigrant communities across the city.
articles.description: People stopped for minor traffic violations will no longer be referred to US Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

articles.headline: Sonia Gandhi's memoir to release in November
articles.title: Sonia Gandhi’s memoir to revisit love, loss and her decision to decline India’s top job
articles.summary: Indian National Congress leader and Rajya Sabha Member Sonia Gandhi has written a memoir titled Belonging: A Journey of Love, scheduled for publication on November 10, 2026, by Alfred A. Knopf. The 79-year-old politician reflects on marrying into the Nehru-Gandhi dynasty, personal tragedies including the assassinations of family members, her political career, and her decision to decline the position of Prime Minister.
articles.description: ‘It was heartbreak and loss that threw me into the public world of politics. Up till then I had guarded my privacy fiercely,’ Sonia Gandhi said in her statement

articles.headline: Rahul Gandhi challenges Narendra Modi to debate
articles.title: Don’t confuse PM Modi, convince him for open debate with me: Rahul Gandhi to Amit Shah
articles.summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi urged Home Minister Amit Shah on November 6, 2026, to convince Prime Minister Narendra Modi to engage in an open debate regarding the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Gandhi issued the challenge after Shah stated the government was open to a special parliamentary session. Bharatiya Janata Party leaders dismissed the challenge, noting that Parliament already serves as the appropriate venue for debate.
articles.description: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has also said the Prime Minister should come forward and face the questions on vote theft that the nation was posing

articles.headline: Rising West Asia conflict freight costs squeeze Keralam export shipments
articles.title: Why soaring freight costs amid West Asia conflict are squeezing Keralam exports
articles.summary: Exports of spices and perishables from Keralam face headwinds due to soaring air freight charges driven by the West Asia conflict. Transportation costs made products less competitive, reducing overseas orders. During the July-September quarter of 2026, cargo exported through four international airports reached 27,425 tonnes, registering a meagre 3.8 percent growth compared to the previous fiscal period when volume was 26,416.7 tonnes.
articles.description: Steep rise in transportation costs has made Kerala products less competitive in overseas markets

articles.headline: Supreme Court grants Telangana control over Miyapur land
articles.title: How did Telangana get back land worth over ₹55,000 crores? | Explained
articles.summary: The Supreme Court of India ruled in favour of the Telangana government on October 29, 2026, granting control over land spread over 550 acres and 39 guntas in Miyapur Village, Serilingampally Mandal, Ranga Reddy district. This ruling concludes a 32-year legal battle and settles a 114-year-old saga involving royal gifts from Nizams who ruled Hyderabad between 1724 and 1948.
articles.description: The Supreme Court settles a 32-year fight, granting Telangana 550 acres of land worth ₹55,000 crores tied to historic jagir deeds

articles.headline: Thomas Markle placed under house detention in Florida after federal charges
articles.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle under house arrest after child sex abuse material charge
articles.summary: Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, was placed under house detention at a Florida assisted living facility after facing a federal charge of possessing child sex abuse material. United States Department of Justice officials stated that the Federal Bureau of Investigation seized seventy-eight items containing illicit material from rented storage units in Los Angeles. Markle entered no plea during a court hearing.
articles.description: The 82-year-old appeared in court in Florida after the FBI searched two Los Angeles-area storage units he rented.

articles.headline: Tribal leader Nisha Bhagat dies by suicide after Facebook live in Ranchi
articles.title: Jharkhand tribal leader found dead after Facebook live; alleges harassment by Soren govt., land brokers
articles.summary: Tribal leader and activist Nisha Bhagat died by suicide in Ranchi on November 6, 2026, shortly after broadcasting a live video on Facebook. During the transmission, she accused Chief Minister Hemant Soren and local police of harassment regarding land rights advocacy. Opposition leader Babulal Marandi criticized the administration and demanded an immediate Central Bureau of Investigation probe into the tragic incident.
articles.description: In the Facebook live, targeting the State Government, Nisha Bhagat said she is now paying the price for bringing the Government’s shortcomings to the public domain and exposing them

articles.headline: Political rivals in Uttar Pradesh spar over Lord Krishna controversy
articles.title: New Analysis: Is the Dhirendra Shastri controversy a springboard to make Lord Krishna an electoral symbol ahead of U.P. polls?
articles.summary: Political rivals in Uttar Pradesh are sparring over Lord Krishna following recent flippant remarks made by storyteller Dhirendra Shastri during an October 29 event in Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh. Analysts view the controversy as a catalyst for the Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi movement before the Assembly elections. A poster at the Bharatiya Janata Party headquarters in Lucknow proclaimed that those who brought Ram will now bring Krishna.
articles.description: The BJP’s strategic silence on the young religious storyteller’s disparaging comments on Lord Krishna suggests a plan to bring the Krishna Janmabhoomi issue into public discourse and question SP leadership’s commitment to their patron deity.

articles.headline: Tribal activist Nisha Bhagat last rites held as BJP demands CBI probe
articles.title: Jharkhand tribal activist Nisha Bhagat’s last rites to be held in Gumla, BJP demands CBI probe
articles.summary: The mortal remains of tribal activist Nisha Kumari Bhagat, who allegedly took her own life in Ranchi after accusing the Hemant Soren government and land brokers of harassment during a Facebook Live session on November 6, 2026, were cremated in Gumla district on November 7, 2026. The incident sparked political reactions, with the Bharatiya Janata Party demanding a CBI inquiry and the resignation of the Chief Minister.
articles.description: Before her death on November 6, Nisha Bhagat accused the Hemant Soren-led State Government and land brokers of harassing her during a Facebook Live session

articles.headline: Pope Leo XIV begins Latin America tour following lung cancer surgery
articles.title: Pope in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrived in Montevideo, Uruguay, on his sixth international tour, stating he is in good health just three weeks after lung cancer surgery. The 71-year-old pontiff will cover over 20,000 miles across Argentina and Peru during the twelve-day journey. Addressing crowds in Plaza Independencia, he emphasized that universal healthcare must remain accessible to everyone globally.
articles.description: Pope Leo travels to Uruguay just three weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.

articles.headline: Assam Oil India Limited facility fire death toll rises to two
articles.title: Assam OIL facility fire death toll rises to two
articles.summary: The death toll at an Oil India Limited facility in Dibrugarh reached two after injured worker Tapas Gogoi passed away at a private hospital. The incident originated from an explosion at an indirect bath heater during maintenance, prompting Oil India Limited to establish an internal inquiry committee to determine the underlying causes and prevent future accidents.
articles.description: Five other workers injured in the incident are undergoing treatment

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister orders allocation for college laptop scheme
articles.title: CM Vijay orders ₹2,000-crore allocation to implement Vetri Laptop Scheme for college students
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay sanctioned two thousand crore rupees to fund the Vetri Laptop Scheme aimed at improving students' technological capabilities. Undergraduate and diploma attendees across various academic disciplines in government institutions will receive devices procured and monitored by the Electronics Corporation of Tamil Nadu under executive oversight.
articles.description: Under the scheme, students pursuing first- and second-year undergraduate and diploma courses in government and government-aided colleges during the 2026-2027 academic year will be eligible for laptops

articles.headline: Carlos Alcaraz saves match points to reach Paris Masters semifinals
articles.title: Carlos Alcaraz saves match points to reach Paris Masters semifinals
articles.summary: Spanish tennis player Carlos Alcaraz saved two match points to defeat Taylor Fritz at the Paris Masters. The victory advanced the twenty-three-year-old to the tournament semifinals for the first time. Alcaraz will face Casper Ruud next. Meanwhile, Ben Shelton also advanced after beating Tommy Paul, ending qualification hopes for the ATP Finals in Turin for both Paul and Fritz.
articles.description: Seven-time Grand Slam champion Alcaraz is through to the Paris Masters semifinals for the first time in his career.

articles.headline: Stanford researchers implant human neurons into laboratory mice brains
articles.title: ‘Alien-cortical’ mice: Can human brain cells grow inside animals?
articles.summary: Scientists at Stanford University in California successfully implanted lab-grown human brain tissue into genetically modified mice lacking a cerebral cortex. According to a study published in Nature, the human organoids grew significantly inside the rodents and improved cognitive performance during maze tests. Researchers stopped the experiments at six months to prevent complex neurological connections or potential signs of consciousness.
articles.description: Modified mice with human brain cells ignite debates over neurohybrids and the future of cross-species medical research.

articles.headline: Usman Khawaja disputes 2018 ball-tampering investigation findings in autobiography
articles.title: Australian cricketer Usman Khawaja disputes findings in 2018 ball-tampering probe
articles.summary: Former Australian cricketer Usman Khawaja claimed in his new autobiography that discussions regarding ball-tampering during the tour of South Africa were widespread throughout the entire team. His account challenges the official Cricket Australia investigation from two thousand eighteen, which concluded prior knowledge was limited to three players. Cricket Australia defended its original integrity process while stating it remains open to receiving relevant information.
articles.description: The "Sandpapergate" scandal over Australia's scuffing ⁠of the ball with sandpaper in the March 2018 test in Cape Town sparked a major integrity crisis for Cricket ‌Australia

articles.headline: Paraguay’s Pena under military protection in bank collapse chaos
articles.title: Paraguay’s Pena under military protection in bank collapse chaos
articles.description: Paraguay moves ex-President Santiago Pena to military base for protection after dramatic day in Asuncion.

articles.headline: Usman Khawaja claims entire Australian team knew about ball-tampering
articles.title: Khawaja claims entire Australia team knew about 2018 ball-tampering scandal
articles.summary: Former opening batsman Usman Khawaja stated in an autobiography excerpt that the entire Australian squad possessed prior knowledge of the twenty-eighteen ball-tampering scandal in Cape Town. The allegations contradict Cricket Australia's initial investigation, which penalized three players. Cricket Australia issued a statement reaffirming confidence in its original findings while maintaining that the organization remains open to considering new evidence.
articles.description: The 'Sandpapergate' scandal saw ⁠Australia scuffing the ball with sandpaper in the March 2018 test ​in Cape Town.

articles.headline: Madras High Court orders enquiry into library book procurement irregularities
articles.title: Library book ‘scam’: Madras High Court had sounded warning two years ago, called for enquiry
articles.summary: The Madras High Court directed the government to establish a committee to investigate widespread irregularities in public library book procurement across Tamil Nadu. According to the court, fraudsters systematically repackaged nationalised and expired books with false titles. Justices R. Mahadevan and G.R. Swaminathan instructed the Director of Public Libraries to maintain a transparent website for future purchases to prevent recurrence.
articles.description: Against the backdrop of writer Perumal Murugan’s expose on substandard books containing grossly erroneous historical information making their way into the shelves of the Periyar Arivulagam in Coimbatore, it would be worthwhile to take a look at how the court had sought to streamline procurement of books

articles.headline: Lung cancer cases rise faster among women in Karnataka
articles.title: Lung cancer rising faster among women in Karnataka
articles.summary: Data from the Kidwai Memorial Institute of Oncology reveals that lung cancer incidence is increasing more rapidly among women than men in Karnataka. The average annual age-adjusted rate grew by 4.8 percent for women, compared with 1.6 percent for men. This rising trend emerges as November is observed globally as Lung Cancer Awareness Month to highlight prevention and early detection.
articles.description: While men account for a higher number of cases, incidence among women is increasing at a faster rate, data shows

articles.headline: Secret Service arrests armed suspect near White House threatening Trump
articles.title: Secret Service arrests man near White House after he said he heard voices telling him to kill Trump
articles.summary: United States Secret Service officers arrested Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos near the White House after discovering multiple firearms and ammunition in his vehicle. According to the Department of Homeland Security, the Venezuelan migrant claimed voices instructed him to kill President Donald Trump. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin commended the officers, while Chrinos remains in custody facing federal charges.
articles.description: U.S. officials say the suspect, Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos, then went on to describe voices in his head that were telling him to come to the nation’s capital and kill the Republican President

articles.headline: Bengaluru IT engineer remanded in police custody for threatening Bollywood actors
articles.title: Bengaluru IT engineer arrested for threatening Bollywood actors, remanded in police custody till November 10
articles.summary: A Mumbai court remanded thirty-year-old IT engineer Vaibhav Mishra in police custody until November 10 following his arrest by the Mumbai Crime Branch. Authorities allege Mishra posed as a member of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang to threaten actors Tusshar Kapoor and Ayushmann Khurrana while demanding five crore rupees via Instagram. Investigators are currently examining mobile data and threatening audio recordings to verify his claims.
articles.description: According to the police, Mishra allegedly contacted celebrities through Instagram, claiming to be associated with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang and issuing threats while demanding money.

articles.headline: Kochi police book doctor for sexual assault following robbery complaint
articles.title: Kochi doctor booked for sexual assault a day after actors’ arrest on his complaint
articles.summary: Infopark police in Kochi booked 41-year-old doctor Johnson Varghese on November 6, 2026, for the alleged sexual assault of a woman. The case followed a complaint filed by a relative of an accused individual. A day prior, police had arrested two film actors and an accomplice for allegedly assaulting and robbing Dr. Varghese of valuables worth ₹3.25 lakh.
articles.description: The Infopark police registered the case against the doctor on a complaint filed by a relative of one of the accused; he allegedly abused the woman after giving her intoxicants, say police

articles.headline: Former U.S. Senator Jay Rockefeller dies at age 89
articles.title: Jay Rockefeller, heir to famed dynasty and healthcare advocate in U.S. Senate, dies at 89
articles.summary: John D. Jay Rockefeller IV, a prominent American politician and former five-term Democratic senator representing West Virginia, passed away at his Washington home. Serving three decades in the Senate, he championed healthcare expansion for low-income populations and later criticized the 2003 Iraq war authorization. His family did not disclose the cause of death for the 89-year-old former governor.
articles.description: Jay Rockefeller, a tall, soft-spoken Democrat with liberal views, was a great-grandson of oil tycoon John ‌D. Rockefeller and the scion of a family that formed a political dynasty

articles.headline: Haiti prime minister celebrates police killing of Boston gang leader
articles.title: ‘One less gang leader’: Haiti’s prime minister celebrates police operation
articles.summary: Haitian National Police confirmed the death of Boston gang leader Mathias Saintil during an enforcement operation in Port-au-Prince. Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aime celebrated the outcome on social media as efforts continue to liberate the country from rampant gang violence. The nation has faced severe instability and displacement since the 2021 assassination of President Jovenel Moise.
articles.description: Haiti's National Police announced that alleged gang leader Mathias Saintil was killed in an exchange of gunfire.

articles.headline: Why are these Beed women farmers staring at a dark Diwali this year? | Pulse Maharashtra
articles.title: Why are these Beed women farmers staring at a dark Diwali this year? | Pulse Maharashtra
articles.description: This Diwali, the women farmers of Takarwan village in Beed say, their dreams have shattered. One of the worst droughts in Maharashtra has caused them immense losses. Now, their only hope is the Employment Guarantee Schemes, which have so far been an undelivered promise. While the state government has said it will inject over Rs 6000 crore for employment guarantee schemes this drought season, for these women it has meant an empty promise so far.

articles.headline: Enforcement Directorate registers money-laundering case over failed Messi match
articles.title: Messi’s Keralam visit row: ED registers money-laundering case
articles.summary: The Directorate of Enforcement initiated a money-laundering investigation into financial irregularities surrounding a canceled 2025 international friendly match featuring Lionel Messi in Kochi. Authorities filed an enforcement report against Anto Augustine and Reporter Broadcasting Company, following a police first information report alleging criminal conspiracy and cheating regarding stadium deposits.
articles.description: Kochi unit of ED registers Enforcement Case Information Report (ECIR) against Anto Augustine, the authorised signatory of Reporter Broadcasting Company Private Limited, and the company itself, based on FIR filed by Kalamassery police

articles.headline: US sanctions eight Canadian currency businesses over alleged Iranian sanctions evasion
articles.title: US Treasury sanctions eight Canadian money exchange firms over Iran ties
articles.summary: The United States Department of the Treasury announced financial penalties on eight currency-exchange firms located in Ontario and British Columbia for allegedly aiding Iranian entities and laundering proceeds into digital assets. The measures, introduced as part of Operation Economic Outcast, bar the companies from US transactions and freeze their American assets. Canadian financial intelligence agency FINTRAC collaborated with US authorities on the action.
articles.description: US Treasury claims firms helped sanctioned Iranian entities and handled funds linked to alleged drug trafficking boss.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh prepares to count votes for rural local body elections
articles.title: Counting of votes, declaration of results on November 7 for ZPTC, MPTC elections in A.P.
articles.summary: The State Election Commission has arranged vote counting across 365 centres for Zilla Parishad and Mandal Parishad Territorial Constituencies following elections held on November 5, 2026. State Election Commissioner Anil Chandra Punetha noted that polling achieved a 70.72% turnout. Authorities deployed nearly 40000 personnel and implemented three-layer security measures including drones and CCTV cameras to oversee the process.
articles.description: About 11,000 counting supervisors and 28,692 assistants/staff to participate in the process at 365 centres across the State; counting of postal ballots to be taken up first; nearly 20,000 police personnel deployed as part of three-layer security

articles.headline: Why are flight tickets so expensive now? The truth behind rising airfares | Explained
articles.title: Why are flight tickets so expensive now? The truth behind rising airfares | Explained
articles.description: Have you noticed that domestic flight tickets in India have become significantly more expensive? According to the Consumer Price Index, domestic airfares were nearly 30% higher in September compared to a year earlier. But what is driving this surge? In this explainer, The Hindu’s aviation reporter Jagriti Chandra breaks down the factors behind rising airfares, including higher aviation fuel prices, the impact of global oil markets, rupee depreciation, airspace restrictions, geopolitical tensions, airline capacity constraints and dynamic pricing models.

articles.headline: Maharashtra leases reservoir land for fodder cultivation in drought areas
articles.title: Maharashtra to lease reservoir land for fodder cultivation in 304 drought-hit talukas
articles.summary: The Maharashtra government will lease exposed cultivable land in reservoirs across 304 drought-declared talukas to farmers for growing short-duration fodder crops. Soil and Water Conservation Minister Sanjay Rathod announced the initiative to improve livestock feed availability, specifying that drinking water needs take precedence and prohibiting chemical fertilisers near wells.
articles.description: The decision is aimed at improving fodder availability for livestock in areas affected by rainfall deficiency during the 2026 kharif season.

articles.headline: Protesters storm site of Microsoft’s planned Amsterdam data centre
articles.title: Protesters storm site of Microsoft’s planned Amsterdam data centre
articles.description: Activists in Amsterdam have stormed the site of a proposed Microsoft data centre. Al Jazeera’s Step Vaessen reports.

articles.headline: European Union prosecutors launch probe into Spanish rail network financing fraud
articles.title: EU prosecutor office investigates fatal train crash in Spain
articles.summary: European Union public prosecutors initiated an investigation into potential financing fraud regarding Spain's high-speed rail network following a fatal train crash in Urda that killed 69 passengers. The European Public Prosecutor's Office conducted investigative measures at three Spanish infrastructure organisations. The collision followed a previous crash in January and preceded the resignations of Transport Minister Oscar Puente and rail manager president Luis Pedro Marco de la Pena.
articles.description: The EU office carries out probes at Spanish rail network administrator, safety agency and state auditors.

articles.headline: Somalian tour guide changes global perceptions of Mogadishu through local tourism
articles.title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu
articles.summary: Sucdi Abdul Fattah Abdul Khader works as a local tour guide in Mogadishu, showing international visitors beaches, historic sites and markets to counter negative media stereotypes of conflict. According to the country's tourism department, ten thousand tourists visited Somalia in 2024, representing a fifty percent increase from the previous year. Foreign travellers say the welcoming atmosphere and coastal scenery starkly contrast with ongoing security challenges.
articles.description: For some tourists, the contrast between Somalia's reputation and what they experience on the ground can be striking.

articles.headline: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma to approach courts regarding residence threats
articles.title: Zubeen Garg case: Assam CM flags danger to family in threat to besiege his house
articles.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma announced on November 6, 2026, that the state government will notify the Supreme Court and Gauhati High Court regarding threats from a group led by an MLA to gherao his residence. The group warned of protests if bail is granted to prime accused Shyamkanu Mahanta and Siddhartha Sharma in the Zubeen Garg death case, which Sarma condemned as a direct danger to his family.
articles.description: He told journalists in Guwahati that he would bring the threat to the notice of the Supreme Court and the Gauhati High Court, as it could amount to an attempt to murder

articles.headline: Pope Leo XIV arrives for South American tour after cancer surgery
articles.title: Pope Leo XIV arrives for South American tour after cancer surgery
articles.description: Pope Leo XIV arrives in Uruguay kicking off a 12-day tour of South America after undergoing lung surgery last month.

articles.headline: MTG warns Miller-Wiles shakeup will sink Republican chances in 2028
articles.title: MTG warns Miller-Wiles shakeup will sink Republican chances in 2028
articles.description: Marjorie Taylor Greene says Trump's White House personnel shuffle will sink the party’s next presidential campaign.

articles.headline: New Zealanders vote in general election amid economic concerns
articles.title: New Zealanders vote in tightly contested general election
articles.summary: Polling stations opened across New Zealand on the final day of voting in a tightly contested general election dominated by economic concerns and the cost of living. The Electoral Commission reported that more than 1.6 million voters cast ballots prior to the final day, with preliminary results expected following the closure of polling places.
articles.description: More than half of New Zealand’s voters cast early ballots in the tightly contested race.

articles.headline: Cornell faculty passes no confidence vote over leadership handling sexual assault allegations
articles.title: Cornell faculty pass no-confidence vote over leadership's handling of Jane Doe allegations
articles.summary: Academic staff at Cornell University passed a symbolic no-confidence vote against central administrators regarding their response to a former student's gang rape allegations involving the Chi Phi fraternity. President Michael Kotlikoff faces criticism over the institution's handling of the case, though the board of trustees maintains support. Meanwhile, New York state prosecutors and state police are conducting separate investigations into the matter.
articles.description: Friday's resolution by academic staff is largely symbolic as they do not have the power to remove those in charge of the university.

articles.headline: Donald Trump struggles to control narrative following US midterms defeat
articles.title: How Trump’s unconvincing narrative on Iran lost him the US midterms
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump faced significant political fallout following a historic defeat for Republicans in the most expensive election in American history. Contributors analyzed the Democratic sweep, media changes in Serbia involving Aleksandar Vucic, and the launch of Equator magazine by former mainstream media journalists during discussions on global politics.
articles.description: Donald Trump and the Republicans struggle to spin a historic defeat in the US midterms.

articles.headline: Mirwaiz Umar Farooq placed under house detention and barred from prayers
articles.title: Disallowed Friday prayers, under house detention for 6th day: Mirwaiz
articles.summary: Kashmir chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq stated that authorities prevented him from leading Friday prayers at Jama Masjid in Srinagar for the second consecutive week. Placed under house detention with heavy police barricades outside his residence in the Nigeen area, the religious leader denounced the restrictions as arbitrary measures intended to suppress freedom of expression and contradict official claims of regional normalcy following his previous sermon.
articles.description: On the previous Friday, the Mirwaiz mentioned in his sermon the findings of the International Crisis Group report on Jammu and Kashmir and highlighted the concerns over political prisoners, civil liberties and the need for meaningful political engagement and reconciliation

articles.headline: Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at Texas factory
articles.title: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck
articles.summary: Tesla plans to wind down production of its Cybertruck vehicles at its Texas factory next year to focus on self-driving Cybercab cars, according to Elon Musk. Lead engineer Wes Morrill suggested the vehicle is being discontinued. Launched in 2023 following numerous delays and a famous glass-shattering demonstration, the angular truck experienced disappointing sales and several safety recalls.
articles.description: Musk said it was to make room for production of its Cybercabs - autonomous taxis without a driver.

articles.headline: Palestinian couples tie the knot in mass wedding in Gaza
articles.title: Palestinian couples tie the knot in mass wedding in Gaza
articles.description: The event brought 250 couples together to celebrate love and new beginnings despite Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza.

articles.headline: Technology shares recover after massive market sell-off wiped trillions in value
articles.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
articles.summary: Global technology companies experienced a recovery in early trading after a severe market rout began in the United States and spread to Asian and European exchanges. The rebound followed the release of unexpected US employment data showing the economy added 165000 jobs in October alongside a slight decline in the unemployment rate to 41% according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
articles.description: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

articles.headline: Dutch protesters occupy Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam
articles.title: Protesters break into Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam
articles.summary: Demonstrators breached the Amsterdam construction perimeter on Friday to halt infrastructure expansion, leading to between 150 and 200 arrests by law enforcement. Activists from the Geef Tegengas group and pro-Palestinian factions opposed the facility over environmental and surveillance concerns. Similar demonstrations occurred across multiple European nations as grassroots movements challenge the rapid development of digital infrastructure and artificial intelligence workloads.
articles.description: Data centres face protests across Europe due to the massive amounts of computing power and water they use.

articles.headline: Thomas Markle Sr arrested in the US over child abuse material
articles.title: Meghan Markle’s father arrested in US over alleged child sex abuse photos
articles.summary: Thomas Markle Sr, the estranged father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, was arrested in Florida following the discovery of sexually explicit photographs involving underage girls in two Los Angeles area storage units. The Department of Justice announced the arrest, noting he faces up to twenty years in prison if convicted on federal charges.
articles.description: US authorities found sexually explicit photos that appeared to show Thomas Markle with prepubescent girls.

articles.headline: Migrants arrive in Spain’s Canary Islands after being rescued at sea
articles.title: Migrants arrive in Spain’s Canary Islands after being rescued at sea
articles.description: More than 3,200 migrants were rescued in the first six days of November in Canary Islands, Spain.

articles.headline: Pope Leo arrives in Uruguay to begin South American tour
articles.title: Pope Leo XIV arrives in Uruguay starting 12-day Latin America tour
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrived in Montevideo to launch a twelve-day tour of South America, marking his first major international trip since undergoing lung cancer surgery in October. The seventy-one-year-old pontiff will visit Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru, engaging with local communities and addressing regional challenges despite prior doubts regarding his travel fitness.
articles.description: The pontiff praises Uruguay's clean energy transition and calls for universal healthcare.

articles.headline: Supreme Court rules temporary cultivators ineligible for forest rights protection
articles.title: Agasthyamalai conservation case: SC directs temporary and non-resident silk cotton cultivators not eligible for protection under FRA Act
articles.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that individuals with temporary residence or living outside forest boundaries cannot claim traditional dweller status solely through silk cotton cultivation in the Agasthyamalai biosphere. Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta mandated strict adherence to eviction plans while questioning the commercial nature of the agricultural activities.

articles.headline: How ‘Street Medics’ protect French protesters
articles.title: How ‘Street Medics’ protect French protesters
articles.description: French authorities are investigating more than a hundred cases of alleged police misconduct at cost of living protests.

articles.headline: Renowned climate scientist P.V. Joseph passes away at age ninety-four
articles.title: Climate scientist P.V. Joseph passes away
articles.summary: Climate scientist P.V. Joseph passed away at age ninety-four. He joined the India Meteorological Department in 1957, later directing its training school and serving as professor at Cochin University of Science and Technology. He discovered the low-level monsoon jetstream, published around 70 research articles, and received several awards including the Sir Gilbert Walker Gold Medal in 2021.
articles.description: He discovered the low-level monsoon jetstream and conducted extensive research on monsoon onset, Rossby waves, and ocean-atmosphere instability

articles.headline: Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister welcomes Supreme Court power arrears verdict
articles.title: Supreme Court decision on BBMB arrears a victory for Himachal, says CM Sukhu
articles.summary: Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu hailed a Supreme Court directive ordering Punjab and Haryana to supply nearly twelve thousand million units of electricity over twenty years as a historic victory. The ruling resolves a decades-old dispute over hydroelectric project shares, providing substantial projected revenue to bolster state infrastructure and public services.
articles.description: The order settles a decades-old dispute over Himachal Pradesh’s 7.19% share in the power generated from the projects

articles.headline: Kerala High Court criticises Kochi Corporation over unmaintained footpaths
articles.title: Pedestrian’s death: Kerala HC raps Kochi Corpn. over alleged failure to restore footpaths in city
articles.summary: The Kerala High Court criticised the Kochi Corporation regarding unmaintained footpaths following a private bus accident in Kakkanad that caused a 28-year-old woman's death. The court instructed authorities to ensure pedestrian safety and strict action against overspeeding buses. Deputy Commissioner of Police Arun K. Pavithran reported that employee details are being recorded through a Smart ID system and complaint numbers will be displayed on vehicles.
articles.description: Court observes that the woman killed in the Kakkanad accident had no space to move aside to avoid the oncoming bus, and reiterates that the right to pedestrian paths is a fundamental right

articles.headline: Tanzanian opposition leader jailed in ‘politically motivated’ case
articles.title: Tanzanian opposition leader jailed in ‘politically motivated’ case
articles.description: Tanzanian opposition leader Tundu Lissu has been jailed in a case widely condemned as politically motivated.

articles.headline: Why is Britain refusing to pay slavery reparations?
articles.title: Why is Britain refusing to pay slavery reparations?
articles.description: Britain compensated slave owners, not the enslaved. Can an apology without reparations be enough?

articles.headline: Telangana introduces climate resilience plan featuring cool roofs and bamboo shelters
articles.title: Bamboo shelters, cool roofs to climate-proof Telangana cities
articles.summary: Telangana is implementing a comprehensive climate action plan to build urban resilience against rising temperatures and extreme weather through a project pipeline worth twenty thousand crore rupees. According to municipal officials, the long-term vision incorporates mandatory urban road codes, cool roof policies, and extensive waste bio-mining programmes designed to reduce emissions, reclaim land, and expand wastewater treatment across local bodies by 2047.
articles.description: The State is drawing up a ₹20,000-crore project pipeline and a series of policy measures to prepare its cities for rising temperatures and erratic rainfall. The plan, which also includes waste reclamation, sewage treatment and digital monitoring of water supply, seeks to build climate resilience across urban local bodies

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu political leaders demand investigation into library book procurement fraud
articles.title: Periyar Arivulagam books row: political leaders raise concern over allegations, call for action
articles.summary: Prominent political figures in Tamil Nadu have expressed serious concern and called for immediate investigations following allegations by writer Perumal Murugan regarding fraudulent book procurements at the newly inaugurated Periyar Arivulagam public library in Coimbatore. Leaders urged authorities to audit all library materials, remove artificially generated books, and investigate suspicious publishing houses involved in supplying the institution.
articles.description: Kamal Haasan demands the immediate withdrawal of the fake books from all libraries. M.H. Jawahirullah wants the formation of an independent committee to examine all books procured for the public library. Others, including Anbumani Ramadoss and K. Annamalai, want the government to take up a thorough investigation of the allegations

articles.headline: Israeli forces close Hebron mosque to Palestinians for Jewish religious holiday
articles.title: Israel closes Hebron’s Ibrahimi Mosque to Palestinians for Jewish holiday
articles.summary: Israeli authorities closed the Ibrahimi Mosque in the occupied West Bank city of Hebron to Palestinian worshippers to accommodate thousands of Israeli settlers arriving for an annual holiday commemorating Sarah. According to the Palestinian Ministry of Religious Endowments, employees were barred and the call to prayer was suspended while security forces tightened movement restrictions throughout the Old City.
articles.description: Contested West Bank holy site is reopened exclusively for Israelis, deepening tensions over control of the mosque.
